guide.summary: How long and how many times are complements: they go AFTER the verb (学了两年, 去过两次), while the time WHEN something happens goes before it. The one idea: the verb comes first, then the amount. The amount moves in front of the verb only when the action did not happen (两年没见).

subs.label: Duration after the verb
subs.focus: No object at issue. Learner must put the duration (两年, 三个小时, 一会儿, 很久) after the verb and 了, not in the time-when slot. Classic error: 我两个小时睡了. Include habits and plans without 了. Never use duration + 就/都 + verb as a wrong option: that 'within' pattern is correct.

subs.label: Duration with an object
subs.focus: Thing object or verb-object word (睡觉, 游泳, 聊天). Learner must choose V+了+duration+(的)+O or verb-copy V+O+V+了+duration. Classic errors: 我学了中文两年, 我学中文了两年, 我睡觉了八个小时. Order items: give both forms as alts if the tiles allow. 来/去/到/毕业/结婚 only in 'time since' items.

subs.label: Pronoun or person object: 等了他半天
subs.focus: Object is a pronoun (他, 我, 你们). Learner must put it BEFORE the duration: 等了他半天, 教了我们两年. Classic errors: 等了半天他, 等了半天的他. Use pronouns in wrong options; with a noun like 小王 the other order is not clearly wrong. Verbs: 等, 找, 教, 陪, 照顾, 帮.

subs.label: 了 … 了: still going on
subs.focus: Learner must decide one 了 (stretch that is over) versus 了 + duration + 了 (so far, still going). Force it with context: 现在还在…, 还没来 for double 了; 以前, 后来, a past time for single 了. Also test the place of the second 了: at the very end, after the object.

subs.label: Negative: duration before 没
subs.focus: 'Have not done it for X': learner must put the duration BEFORE 没 + verb, with final 了 if still true: 我们两年没见了. Classic error: 我们没见两年了. Rewrites: positive to negative moves the duration forward. Do not mark 没 + V + duration wrong where it denies the amount (没学两年，只学了一年).

subs.label: 次 / 遍 / 趟 / 回 / 下 after the verb
subs.focus: (1) Position: number + 次/遍/趟/回/下 follows the verb and 了/过; classic error 我两次去过. (2) Choice: 遍 whole thing through, 趟 round trip, 下 brief action, 次/回 occasions. 次 is often also acceptable (去一次/一趟, 再说一次/一遍): never use it as a distractor there; use real mismatches (去了一遍, 看了一趟).

subs.label: Frequency with an object
subs.focus: Learner must order object and count: pronoun BEFORE the count (见过他一次, 等我一下); place either side (去过两次北京 / 去过北京两次: both as alts); thing AFTER the count (打了三次电话); split verb-object words (见过一次面). Judge-wrong items only on clear errors: 见过一次他, 见面过一次, 见面过他.

subs.label: Time-when before, duration after
subs.focus: Learner must tell a point in time (三点, 三月, 星期二, 去年) from a length (三个小时, 三个月, 两个星期, 一年): point before the verb, length after. Use pairs 两点/两个小时, 三月/三个月 and sentences with both. Classic errors: 我睡觉十一点, 我住了三月 for 'three months', 我八个小时睡觉.

rules.rule: How long an action lasts goes after the verb. If the action is finished or measured so far, 了 sits between the verb and the duration.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上睡了八个小时。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí
examples.en: I slept for eight hours last night.

examples.py: tā zài shàng hǎi zhù le sān nián
examples.en: He lived in Shanghai for three years.

examples.py: wǒ men xiū xi yī huì r ba
examples.en: Let's rest for a while.

examples.py: tā měi tiān gōng zuò shí gè xiǎo shí
examples.en: She works ten hours every day.

rules.note: Habits and plans take no 了, but the duration still follows the verb. A duration before the verb exists with other meanings: 'within that time' (我两个小时就写完了, I finished it in just two hours) and 'per period' (一天吃三次, three times a day). Those are not the 'for how long' pattern.

rules.rule: With a thing as object, put the duration between the verb and the object; 的 after the duration is optional.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 了 + duration + (的) + Object

examples.py: wǒ xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén
examples.en: I studied Chinese for two years.

examples.zh: 他看了一个晚上的电视。
examples.py: tā kàn le yī gè wǎn shang de diàn shì
examples.en: He watched television all evening.

examples.zh: 我每天坐一个小时的地铁。
examples.py: wǒ měi tiān zuò yī gè xiǎo shí de dì tiě
examples.en: I ride the subway for an hour every day.

rules.note: Words like 睡觉, 游泳, 跑步, 聊天, 上课 are verb + object inside, so they split the same way: 睡了八个小时的觉, 游了一个小时泳. Never 睡觉了八个小时.

rules.rule: Or say the verb twice: first with its object, then again with 了 and the duration. 了 goes only on the second verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + Object + Verb + 了 + duration

examples.py: wǒ xué zhōng wén xué le liǎng nián
examples.en: I studied Chinese for two years.

examples.zh: 她打电话打了一个小时。
examples.py: tā dǎ diàn huà dǎ le yī gè xiǎo shí
examples.en: She was on the phone for an hour.

examples.zh: 我们昨天聊天聊了很久。
examples.py: wǒ men zuó tiān liáo tiān liáo le hěn jiǔ
examples.en: We chatted for a long time yesterday.

rules.note: Both forms mean the same. What is wrong is the English order with an activity verb: Verb + Object + duration (我学了中文两年).

rules.rule: Time since: with verbs that happen in an instant (来, 去, 到, 离开, 毕业, 结婚) the time counts from that moment, so it follows the object and the sentence ends in 了.

examples.py: tā lái zhōng guó sān nián le
examples.en: He has been in China for three years.

examples.py: wǒ men jié hūn shí nián le
examples.en: We have been married for ten years.

examples.py: tā dà xué bì yè liǎng nián le
examples.en: It has been two years since she graduated from university.

rules.note: This is the one case where Verb + Object + duration is right. It does not work for activities that last: 我学中文两年了 is heard in speech, but the forms to learn are 我学了两年中文了 and 我学中文学了两年了.

rules.rule: A pronoun object goes straight after the verb and 了, before the duration. The 的 form is impossible with a pronoun.

examples.py: wǒ děng le tā bàn tiān
examples.en: I waited for him for ages.

examples.py: wáng lǎo shī jiāo le wǒ men liǎng nián
examples.en: Mr. Wang taught us for two years.

examples.py: mā ma zhǎo le nǐ yī gè xià wǔ
examples.en: Mum looked for you all afternoon.

rules.note: A person named with a noun usually follows the pronoun order too (等了小王半天), and verb-copy also works (等小王等了半天). 半天 here means 'a long time', not half a day.

rules.rule: A second 了 at the end of the sentence says the amount is counted up to now and the action is still going on. With one 了 the amount is simply what was done, usually in the past.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 了 + duration + (Object) + 了

examples.zh: 我学了两年中文了，现在还在学。
examples.py: wǒ xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén le xiàn zài hái zài xué
examples.en: I have been studying Chinese for two years, and I'm still studying.

examples.zh: 我以前学了两年中文，后来不学了。
examples.py: wǒ yǐ qián xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén hòu lái bù xué le
examples.en: I studied Chinese for two years before, then gave it up.

examples.zh: 我们已经等了四十分钟了。
examples.py: wǒ men yǐ jīng děng le sì shí fēn zhōng le
examples.en: We have already been waiting for forty minutes.

examples.py: tā zài zhè r zhù le shí nián le
examples.en: He has lived here for ten years.

rules.note: The double 了 is a firm signal of 'so far, still going'. A single 了 is less firm: it normally reads as over, but context decides. The same works for counts: 我看了两遍了 (twice so far). In the verb-copy form the second 了 again goes last: 我学中文学了两年了.

rules.rule: For 'have not done it for this long' the duration goes before 没 + verb. Add 了 at the end when it is still true now.
rules.pattern: Subject + duration + 没 + Verb + (Object) + 了

examples.py: wǒ men liǎng nián méi jiàn le
examples.en: We haven't seen each other for two years.

examples.py: tā sān tiān méi shuì jiào le
examples.en: He hasn't slept for three days.

examples.py: wǒ hěn jiǔ méi chī zhōng guó cài le
examples.en: I haven't had Chinese food for a long time.

examples.zh: 去年我有三个月没工作。
examples.py: qù nián wǒ yǒu sān gè yuè méi gōng zuò
examples.en: Last year I didn't work for three months.

rules.note: Here 没 and the final 了 do go together: the 了 marks the situation so far, not a completed action. 没 + verb + duration is a different sentence that denies the amount: 我没学两年，只学了一年 (I didn't study for two years, only one).

rules.rule: How many times goes after the verb, and after 了 or 过: number + 次 for occasions. 回 is the same in casual speech.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 了/过 + number + 次

examples.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì
examples.en: I have been there twice.

examples.zh: 这个星期他迟到了三次。
examples.py: zhè ge xīng qī tā chí dào le sān cì
examples.en: He was late three times this week.

examples.py: wǒ men yī gè xīng qī jiàn yī cì
examples.en: We meet once a week.

rules.note: The period in 'once a week' (一个星期, 每天) goes before the verb; only the count follows it. 第一次 'the first time' is a time-when expression and goes before the verb: 我第一次来中国.

rules.rule: Pick the word by the kind of action: 遍 = through the whole thing from start to finish; 趟 = a trip there and back; 下 = a quick, light action, and 一下 softens a request to 'for a moment'.
rules.pattern: Verb + number + 遍 / 趟 / 下

examples.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn le sān biàn
examples.en: I have read this book three times through.

examples.py: wǒ xià wǔ yào qù yī tàng yín háng
examples.en: I need to make a trip to the bank this afternoon.

examples.py: qǐng děng yī xià
examples.en: Please wait a moment.

examples.py: qǐng nǐ zài shuō yī biàn
examples.en: Please say it once more.

rules.note: 次 can often replace 遍 or 趟 with a small loss of meaning (看了三次 just counts occasions, maybe not to the end; 去一次银行 is fine). The reverse fails: 遍 cannot count trips and 趟 cannot count readings. 一下 does not count: 看一下 is 'have a look', not 'look once'.

rules.rule: Pronoun object: before the count. Place object: either side of the count. Other noun objects: after the count.
rules.pattern: Verb + 过/了 + pronoun + count  |  Verb + 过/了 + count + place/thing

examples.py: wǒ jiàn guo tā yī cì
examples.en: I have met him once.

examples.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì běi jīng
examples.en: I have been to Beijing twice.

examples.py: wǒ qù guo běi jīng liǎng cì
examples.en: I have been to Beijing twice.

examples.zh: 他今天给我打了三次电话。
examples.py: tā jīn tiān gěi wǒ dǎ le sān cì diàn huà
examples.en: He phoned me three times today.

rules.note: 一下 follows the same rule: 等我一下, 问他一下, but 看一下这个, 用一下你的手机. A specific thing (这本书, 那个电影) usually moves to the front as topic instead: 那个电影我看过两遍. A person named with a noun can go on either side (见过小王一次 / 见过一次小王).

rules.rule: Verb-object words (见面, 洗澡, 游泳, 生病, 请假) split: 过/了 and the count go in the middle. They cannot take another object after them.
rules.pattern: Verb + 过/了 + count + Object part

examples.py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo yī cì miàn
examples.en: We have only met once.

examples.py: wǒ gēn tā jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn
examples.en: I have met him twice.

examples.py: tā shàng gè yuè qǐng le sān cì jià
examples.en: He took leave three times last month.

rules.rule: A point in time (when) goes before the verb; a length of time (how long) goes after it. Both can appear in one sentence. Check the form: 两点 is a time, 两个小时 a length; 三月 is March, 三个月 three months.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上十一点睡觉。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shí yī diǎn shuì jiào
examples.en: I went to bed at eleven last night.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上睡了九个小时。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì le jiǔ gè xiǎo shí
examples.en: I slept for nine hours last night.

examples.zh: 他三月去北京，在那儿住三个月。
examples.py: tā sān yuè qù běi jīng zài nà r zhù sān gè yuè
examples.en: He is going to Beijing in March and will stay there for three months.

examples.zh: 我星期二下午上了两个小时的课。
examples.py: wǒ xīng qī èr xià wǔ shàng le liǎng gè xiǎo shí de kè
examples.en: I had two hours of class on Tuesday afternoon.

rules.note: Lengths: 年, 天 and 分钟 take no 个 (两年, 三天, 十分钟); 月 must have 个 (三个月); 小时 and 星期 normally take 个 (两个小时, 一个星期), though it is sometimes dropped. Two as a length is 两, never 二: 两天, 两个月.

right.py: wǒ kàn le liǎng gè xiǎo shí diàn shì
right.en: I watched television for two hours.

contrasts.why: A length of time is not a time-when. It goes after the verb, not in the slot before it.

right.py: wǒ xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén
right.en: I studied Chinese for two years.

contrasts.why: English puts 'for two years' after the object. Chinese puts the duration between verb and object, or repeats the verb: 我学中文学了两年.

contrasts.wrong: 我昨天睡觉了八个小时。

right.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí
right.en: I slept for eight hours yesterday.

contrasts.why: 睡觉 is verb + object. 了 and the duration attach to 睡, with 觉 dropped or moved to the end (睡了八个小时的觉).

right.py: wǒ děng le tā bàn tiān
right.en: I waited for him for ages.

contrasts.why: A pronoun object comes before the duration, the opposite of an ordinary noun object.

right.py: wǒ men liǎng nián méi jiàn le
right.en: We haven't seen each other for two years.

contrasts.why: When the action did not happen there is nothing after the verb to measure. The period of not doing goes before 没.

contrasts.wrong: 我学了三年中文，现在还在学。

right.zh: 我学了三年中文了，现在还在学。
right.py: wǒ xué le sān nián zhōng wén le xiàn zài hái zài xué
right.en: I have been studying Chinese for three years, and I'm still studying.

contrasts.why: Still going on calls for the second 了 at the end of the clause. With one 了 the three years read as a finished stretch, which sits badly with 现在还在学.

right.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì shàng hǎi
right.en: I have been to Shanghai twice.

contrasts.why: The count follows the verb and 过, like a duration. With a place, 去过上海两次 is equally good.

right.py: wǒ jiàn guo tā yī cì

contrasts.why: A pronoun object goes before the count. Only places and ordinary nouns can follow it.

right.py: zhè ge diàn yǐng wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn
right.en: I have watched this film twice.

contrasts.why: 趟 counts trips. Watching something through from beginning to end is counted with 遍 (次 is also possible).

right.py: wǒ zài běi jīng zhù le sān gè yuè
right.en: I lived in Beijing for three months.

contrasts.why: 三月 is the month of March, a time-when. The length is 三个月, and it goes after the verb.

cheat: How long or how many times? After the verb. When? Before the verb.
Thing object: Verb + 了 + duration + (的) + Object, or Verb + Object + Verb + 了 + duration. Never Verb + Object + duration.
Pronoun object (他, 我, 你们): right after the verb, before the duration or count: 等了他半天, 见过他一次.
Still going on now? Add a second 了 at the very end.
Did not happen for a period? Duration + 没 + Verb (+ 了): 两年没见了.
Place: 去过两次北京 = 去过北京两次. Split verb-object words: 睡了八个小时觉, 见过一次面.
遍 = start to finish, 趟 = there and back, 一下 = for a moment, 次 = occasions. 两点 / 三月 are times; 两个小时 / 三个月 are lengths.

items.q: 医生说我要在家休息___，不能去上班。
items.zh: 医生说我要在家休息三天，不能去上班。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ yào zài jiā xiū xi sān tiān bù néng qù shàng bān
items.en: The doctor says I have to rest at home for three days and can't go to work.
items.why: How long goes after the verb, so you need a length: 三天 is three days of rest. 三点 is a clock time and 三号 a date; neither can measure how long you rest.

items.q: 周末我打算好好睡___十个小时。
items.zh: 周末我打算好好睡十个小时。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ dǎ suàn hǎo hǎo shuì shí gè xiǎo shí
items.en: This weekend I plan to get a good ten hours of sleep.
items.why: A plan has not happened yet, so no 了 sits between 睡 and the duration; 了 would make it finished, and 过 would make it a past experience, both clashing with 打算.

items.q: 我太累了，想在床上睡___。
items.zh: 我太累了，想在床上睡一会儿。
items.py: wǒ tài lèi le xiǎng zài chuáng shàng shuì yī huì r
items.en: I'm too tired; I want to sleep in bed for a little while.
items.why: 一会儿 is a short length of time and follows the verb. 遍 counts run-throughs and 趟 counts round trips, so neither measures how long you sleep.

items.zh: 我昨天睡了九个小时。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì le jiǔ gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I slept for nine hours yesterday.
items.why: The length of sleep follows 睡了, while 昨天 is a time-when and stays before the verb. 九个小时 cannot go in front of 睡.

items.zh: 他在医院住了一个星期。
items.py: tā zài yī yuàn zhù le yī gè xīng qī
items.en: He stayed in the hospital for a week.
items.why: The place 在医院 sits before the verb; the duration 一个星期 comes right after 住了 and cannot be moved in front of it.

items.zh: 她每天要在电脑前坐八个小时。
items.py: tā měi tiān yào zài diàn nǎo qián zuò bā gè xiǎo shí
items.en: She has to sit in front of a computer for eight hours every day.
items.why: Even in a habit, how long goes after the verb: 坐八个小时. 每天 is the when, and the place phrase 在电脑前 sits before 坐.

items.zh: 请你在这儿等十分钟。
items.py: qǐng nǐ zài zhè r děng shí fēn zhōng
items.en: Please wait here for ten minutes.
items.why: A request has no 了, but the duration 十分钟 still follows the verb 等; the place 在这儿 stays in front of it.

items.s: 我昨天晚上八个小时睡了。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang bā gè xiǎo shí shuì le
items.zh: 我昨天晚上睡了八个小时。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I slept for eight hours last night.
items.why: 八个小时 says how long, so it must follow 睡了. Placed before the verb it is read as a time-when slot and the sentence breaks.

items.s: 他半个小时就写完了报告。
items.s_py: tā bàn gè xiǎo shí jiù xiě wán le bào gào
items.zh: 他半个小时就写完了报告。
items.py: tā bàn gè xiǎo shí jiù xiě wán le bào gào
items.en: He finished writing the report in just half an hour.
items.why: Trap: a duration before the verb with 就 means 'within that time', a different pattern from 'for how long', so the sentence is correct.

items.q: 我昨天看___两个小时电视。
items.zh: 我昨天看了两个小时电视。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn le liǎng gè xiǎo shí diàn shì
items.en: I watched TV for two hours yesterday.
items.why: A stretch finished yesterday takes 了 right after the verb, before the duration. 过 would mean having done it at some time, and 着 an ongoing state.

items.q: 我今天早上跑步___半个小时，累死了。
items.zh: 我今天早上跑步跑了半个小时，累死了。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo shang pǎo bù pǎo le bàn gè xiǎo shí lèi sǐ le
items.en: I ran for half an hour this morning and was exhausted.
items.why: 跑步 is verb + object and cannot take a duration straight after it, so repeat the verb: 跑步跑了半个小时. 跑步了半个小时 is wrong.

items.q: 他每周打三个小时___球，身体很好。
items.zh: 他每周打三个小时的球，身体很好。
items.py: tā měi zhōu dǎ sān gè xiǎo shí de qiú shēn tǐ hěn hǎo
items.en: He plays ball for three hours a week and is in good health.
items.why: The duration sits before the object and is linked with 的: 三个小时的球. A habit takes no 了, and 着 cannot go there.

items.q: 老板昨天给客户打电话___了一个小时。
items.zh: 老板昨天给客户打电话打了一个小时。
items.py: lǎo bǎn zuó tiān gěi kè hù dǎ diàn huà dǎ le yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: The boss was on the phone to the client for an hour yesterday.
items.why: With verb-object 打电话, repeat the verb and put 了 plus the duration on the second one. 打电话了了 or a bare 了 after 话 does not work.

items.q: 他来这家公司三年___，对工作已经很熟悉了。
items.zh: 他来这家公司三年了，对工作已经很熟悉了。
items.py: tā lái zhè jiā gōng sī sān nián le duì gōng zuò yǐ jīng hěn shú xī le
items.en: He has been with this company for three years and already knows the work well.
items.why: With the instant verb 来, time since follows the object and the sentence ends in 了. 过 and 着 do not express 'it has been three years now'.

items.zh: 她昨天打了两个小时球。
items.py: tā zuó tiān dǎ le liǎng gè xiǎo shí qiú
items.en: She played ball for two hours yesterday.
items.why: The duration goes between 打了 and its object 球. Verb + object + duration (打了球两个小时) is the English order and is wrong.

items.zh: 经理昨天开会开了三个小时。
items.py: jīng lǐ zuó tiān kāi huì kāi le sān gè xiǎo shí
items.en: The manager was in a meeting for three hours yesterday.
items.why: With the verb-object 开会, say the verb twice: 开会 first, then 开了 plus the duration. The duration cannot follow 会 directly.

items.zh: 她每天看一个小时的手机。
items.py: tā měi tiān kàn yī gè xiǎo shí de shǒu jī
items.en: She spends an hour on her phone every day.
items.why: The duration with 的 comes before the object: 看一个小时的手机. A habit takes no 了.

items.zh: 医生说我每天要游半个小时的泳。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ měi tiān yào yóu bàn gè xiǎo shí de yǒng
items.en: The doctor says I should swim for half an hour every day.
items.why: 游泳 splits around the duration: 游 + 半个小时的 + 泳. Putting the duration after 泳 would be the English order.

items.src: 他昨天游了一个小时泳。
items.src_py: tā zuó tiān yóu le yī gè xiǎo shí yǒng
items.task: Say it by repeating the verb.
items.zh: 他昨天游泳游了一个小时。
items.py: tā zuó tiān yóu yǒng yóu le yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: He swam for an hour yesterday.
items.why: The verb-copy pattern puts the whole verb-object first, then repeats the verb with 了 and the duration. 了 goes only on the second verb.

items.src_py: jīng lǐ kāi le sān gè xiǎo shí huì
items.task: Add 的 after the duration.
items.zh: 经理开了三个小时的会。
items.py: jīng lǐ kāi le sān gè xiǎo shí de huì
items.en: The manager was in a three-hour meeting.
items.why: 的 is optional but links a duration to the object that follows it: 开了三个小时的会. The order verb + duration + object stays the same.

items.src: 她昨天睡觉睡了九个小时。
items.src_py: tā zuó tiān shuì jiào shuì le jiǔ gè xiǎo shí
items.task: Put the duration before 觉 and add 的.
items.zh: 她昨天睡了九个小时的觉。
items.py: tā zuó tiān shuì le jiǔ gè xiǎo shí de jiào
items.en: She slept for nine hours yesterday.
items.why: 睡觉 can split: 睡了 + duration + 的 + 觉. This is the same meaning as repeating the verb, just built the other way.

items.s: 他昨天睡觉了十个小时。
items.s_py: tā zuó tiān shuì jiào le shí gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 他昨天睡了十个小时。
items.py: tā zuó tiān shuì le shí gè xiǎo shí
items.en: He slept for ten hours yesterday.
items.why: 睡觉 is verb + object, so 了 and the duration attach to 睡, not after 觉. Say 睡了十个小时 or 睡了十个小时的觉.

items.s: 我们开了会三个小时。
items.s_py: wǒ men kāi le huì sān gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 我们开了三个小时会。
items.py: wǒ men kāi le sān gè xiǎo shí huì
items.en: We were in a meeting for three hours.
items.why: 开会 is verb + object, so the duration cannot follow 会. Put it between 开了 and 会 (开了三个小时会), or repeat the verb: 开会开了三个小时.

items.s: 为了这个报告，我们小组昨晚加班加了四个小时。
items.s_py: wèi le zhè ge bào gào wǒ men xiǎo zǔ zuó wǎn jiā bān jiā le sì gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 为了这个报告，我们小组昨晚加班加了四个小时。
items.py: wèi le zhè ge bào gào wǒ men xiǎo zǔ zuó wǎn jiā bān jiā le sì gè xiǎo shí
items.en: For this report our team worked overtime for four hours last night.
items.why: Trap: 加班 is verb + object, so the verb is repeated and 了 plus the duration go on the second 加. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 我在医院门口等___半天。
items.zh: 我在医院门口等了他半天。
items.py: wǒ zài yī yuàn mén kǒu děng le tā bàn tiān
items.en: I waited for him at the hospital entrance for ages.
items.why: A pronoun object goes right after the verb and 了, and the duration follows it: 等了他半天. 他了 misplaces 了, and 的 cannot be used with a pronoun.

items.q: 护士陪了___一个晚上，他才睡着。
items.zh: 护士陪了他一个晚上，他才睡着。
items.py: hù shi péi le tā yī gè wǎn shang tā cái shuì zháo
items.en: The nurse stayed with him all night before he finally fell asleep.
items.why: The pronoun 他 comes straight after 陪了, before 一个晚上. 的他 and 他的 turn the pronoun into a modifier and break the pattern.

items.q: 妈妈找了___一个上午，你去哪儿了？
items.zh: 妈妈找了你一个上午，你去哪儿了？
items.py: mā ma zhǎo le nǐ yī gè shàng wǔ nǐ qù nǎ r le
items.en: Mum has been looking for you all morning. Where did you go?
items.why: With a pronoun object the order is Verb + 了 + pronoun + duration: 找了你一个上午. Neither 你的 nor 的你 can sit there.

items.q: 培训部教了___整整两个星期，我们才学会这个新系统。
items.zh: 培训部教了我们整整两个星期，我们才学会这个新系统。
items.py: péi xùn bù jiāo le wǒ men zhěng zhěng liǎng gè xīng qī wǒ men cái xué huì zhè ge xīn xì tǒng
items.en: The training department taught us for two whole weeks before we mastered the new system.
items.why: The pronoun 我们 goes after 教了 and before the duration. Adding 的 before or after it makes it a possessive and the sentence falls apart.

items.zh: 老板等了你半天。
items.py: lǎo bǎn děng le nǐ bàn tiān
items.en: The boss waited for you for ages.
items.why: A pronoun object precedes the duration: 等了你半天. 等了半天你 puts the amount before the person and is wrong.

items.zh: 李医生照顾了我三个星期。
items.py: lǐ yī shēng zhào gù le wǒ sān gè xīng qī
items.en: Doctor Li looked after me for three weeks.
items.why: The pronoun 我 comes right after 照顾了 and the duration 三个星期 follows it.

items.zh: 同事帮了我一个下午。
items.py: tóng shì bāng le wǒ yī gè xià wǔ
items.en: A colleague helped me all afternoon.
items.why: With 我 as the object, the order is verb + 了 + 我 + duration, the reverse of 帮了一个下午的忙 where the object is a thing.

items.src_py: wǒ děng tā děng le bàn tiān
items.task: Say it without repeating the verb.
items.zh: 我等了他半天。
items.py: wǒ děng le tā bàn tiān
items.en: I waited for him for ages.
items.why: Instead of copying the verb, keep one 等了 and put the pronoun 他 directly after it, then the duration 半天.

items.s: 同事找了半天我。
items.s_py: tóng shì zhǎo le bàn tiān wǒ
items.zh: 同事找了我半天。
items.py: tóng shì zhǎo le wǒ bàn tiān
items.en: A colleague looked for me for ages.
items.why: A pronoun object must come before the duration. 找了半天我 reverses them, which Chinese does not allow with 我, 你 or 他.

items.s: 我等你等了一个小时。
items.s_py: wǒ děng nǐ děng le yī gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 我等你等了一个小时。
items.py: wǒ děng nǐ děng le yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I waited for you for an hour.
items.why: Trap: the verb-copy pattern also works with a pronoun object (等你 then 等了一个小时), so this is correct.

items.q: 小王以前在这家公司工作了三年___，后来去了上海。
items.zh: 小王以前在这家公司工作了三年，后来去了上海。
items.py: xiǎo wáng yǐ qián zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò le sān nián hòu lái qù le shàng hǎi
items.en: Xiao Wang used to work at this company for three years, then went to Shanghai.
items.why: 以前 and 后来 show the three years are over, so only the 了 after the verb belongs. A second 了 would say he is still working there.

items.q: 上个月我感冒了一个星期___，现在已经好了。
items.zh: 上个月我感冒了一个星期，现在已经好了。
items.py: shàng gè yuè wǒ gǎn mào le yī gè xīng qī xiàn zài yǐ jīng hǎo le
items.en: Last month I had a cold for a week; I'm better now.
items.why: The cold is over, so the week is a finished stretch with one 了. The second 了 means 'so far, still going', which contradicts 已经好了.

items.q: 去年经理在国外出差了六个月___，今年已经回国了。
items.zh: 去年经理在国外出差了六个月，今年已经回国了。
items.py: qù nián jīng lǐ zài guó wài chū chāi le liù gè yuè jīn nián yǐ jīng huí guó le
items.en: Last year the manager spent six months abroad on business; this year he's back in China.
items.why: 去年 puts the six months entirely in the past, so one 了 only. Adding a final 了 would present the business trip as still going on.

items.zh: 我吃了三个月药了。
items.py: wǒ chī le sān gè yuè yào le
items.en: I have been taking the medicine for three months now.
items.why: Verb + 了 + duration + object, then a final 了 to say the three months run up to now and are not over.

items.zh: 他在这家医院工作了五年了。
items.py: tā zài zhè jiā yī yuàn gōng zuò le wǔ nián le
items.en: He has worked at this hospital for five years.
items.why: The second 了 goes at the very end and marks 'so far, and still going'. The place phrase stays before the verb.

items.zh: 我们已经等了他四十分钟了。
items.py: wǒ men yǐ jīng děng le tā sì shí fēn zhōng le
items.en: We have already been waiting for him for forty minutes.
items.why: The pronoun 他 comes before the duration, and the final 了 marks that the waiting is still going. 已经 sits before the verb.

items.src: 我在这个公司工作了三年。
items.src_py: wǒ zài zhè ge gōng sī gōng zuò le sān nián
items.task: Say you are still working there now.
items.zh: 我在这个公司工作了三年了。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè ge gōng sī gōng zuò le sān nián le
items.en: I have been working at this company for three years.
items.why: To say the three years run up to now and continue, add a second 了 at the end of the sentence, after the duration.

items.src_py: wǒ gǎn mào le sān tiān
items.task: Say it has lasted three days so far and is still going.
items.zh: 我感冒了三天了。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le sān tiān le
items.en: I have had a cold for three days now.
items.why: Adding a final 了 after 三天 turns a plain amount into 'three days so far, and still going'.

items.s: 我以前学了两年中文了，后来不学了。
items.s_py: wǒ yǐ qián xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén le hòu lái bù xué le
items.zh: 我以前学了两年中文，后来不学了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén hòu lái bù xué le
items.en: I studied Chinese for two years before, then gave it up.
items.why: The final 了 says the two years are still counting, but 以前 and 后来不学了 say it ended. Use one 了 only.

items.s: 我头疼了三天了。
items.s_py: wǒ tóu téng le sān tiān le
items.zh: 我头疼了三天了。
items.py: wǒ tóu téng le sān tiān le
items.en: I have had a headache for three days now.
items.why: Trap: two 了 are correct here. The first follows the verb and the second marks that the headache has lasted three days so far.

items.s: 去年夏天他在上海住了三个月了，秋天就回国了。
items.s_py: qù nián xià tiān tā zài shàng hǎi zhù le sān gè yuè le qiū tiān jiù huí guó le
items.zh: 去年夏天他在上海住了三个月，秋天就回国了。
items.py: qù nián xià tiān tā zài shàng hǎi zhù le sān gè yuè qiū tiān jiù huí guó le
items.en: Last summer he lived in Shanghai for three months, then returned to his country in autumn.
items.why: 去年夏天 puts the three months in a finished period, and 回国了 ends it. A final 了 after 三个月 wrongly says it is still going on.

items.s: 我跑步跑了三个月了，体重还是没有变化。
items.s_py: wǒ pǎo bù pǎo le sān gè yuè le tǐ zhòng hái shi méi yǒu biàn huà
items.zh: 我跑步跑了三个月了，体重还是没有变化。
items.py: wǒ pǎo bù pǎo le sān gè yuè le tǐ zhòng hái shi méi yǒu biàn huà
items.en: I've been running for three months now, but my weight hasn't changed.
items.why: Trap: in the verb-copy form the second 了 again goes last, so 跑了三个月了 is correct for 'three months so far, still running'.

items.q: 他___了，眼睛都红了。
items.zh: 他三天没睡觉了，眼睛都红了。
items.py: tā sān tiān méi shuì jiào le yǎn jīng dōu hóng le
items.en: He hasn't slept for three days, and his eyes are red.
items.why: For 'not done for a period', the duration goes before 没: 三天没睡觉了. There is no action after the verb to measure, so the duration cannot follow it.

items.q: 医生说我胃不好，我已经___没喝咖啡了。
items.zh: 医生说我胃不好，我已经一个多月没喝咖啡了。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ wèi bù hǎo wǒ yǐ jīng yī gè duō yuè méi hē kā fēi le
items.en: The doctor says my stomach is bad, and I haven't had coffee for over a month.
items.why: The length 一个多月 goes before 没. 一月 is January, a time-when, and 一点 is one o'clock or 'a bit'; neither is a length of time.

items.q: 小李___没来上班了，听说他病了。
items.zh: 小李一个星期没来上班了，听说他病了。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ yī gè xīng qī méi lái shàng bān le tīng shuō tā bìng le
items.en: Xiao Li hasn't come to work for a week; I heard he's ill.
items.why: The duration 一个星期 comes directly before 没, and the 了 belongs at the end of the clause. 一个星期了没来 splits the pattern; 三号 is a date.

items.q: 因为一直在出差，我已经___没回家吃过饭了。
items.zh: 因为一直在出差，我已经两个多月没回家吃过饭了。
items.py: yīn wèi yī zhí zài chū chāi wǒ yǐ jīng liǎng gè duō yuè méi huí jiā chī guo fàn le
items.en: Because I've been on business trips all along, I haven't eaten at home for over two months.
items.why: The length 两个多月 goes before 没. 两月 lacks the measure 个 that 月 needs for 'months', and 多两个月 is not a possible order.

items.q: 我已经___没跟老同学联系了，真想他们。
items.zh: 我已经很久没跟老同学联系了，真想他们。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng hěn jiǔ méi gēn lǎo tóng xué lián xì le zhēn xiǎng tā men
items.en: I haven't been in touch with my old classmates for a long time; I really miss them.
items.why: 很久 means 'a long time' and goes before 没. 很多 means 'many' and 很长 needs 时间 after it, so neither fits here.

items.zh: 我两天没吃饭了。
items.py: wǒ liǎng tiān méi chī fàn le
items.en: I haven't eaten for two days.
items.why: The duration 两天 goes before 没, and 了 at the end shows the situation still holds. 没吃饭两天 is not possible.

items.zh: 她很久没去医院了。
items.py: tā hěn jiǔ méi qù yī yuàn le
items.en: She hasn't been to the hospital for a long time.
items.why: 很久 goes before 没, not after the verb. The final 了 marks that the state of not going has lasted until now.

items.zh: 我已经一个星期没好好睡觉了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng yī gè xīng qī méi hǎo hǎo shuì jiào le
items.en: I haven't slept properly for a week now.
items.why: 已经 comes first, then the duration, then 没: the duration of not doing always sits in front of 没 and its verb.

items.zh: 我半年没去体检了。
items.py: wǒ bàn nián méi qù tǐ jiǎn le
items.en: I haven't had a medical check-up for half a year.
items.why: 半年 is the length of not doing it, so it goes before 没. Putting it after 去体检 would be the English order and is wrong.

items.src_py: tā měi tiān duàn liàn
items.task: Say he has not exercised for a month.
items.zh: 他一个月没锻炼了。
items.py: tā yī gè yuè méi duàn liàn le
items.en: He hasn't exercised for a month.
items.why: Turning a habit into 'not for a month' moves the duration in front of 没 and adds a final 了, since the situation is still true now.

items.src: 她每个星期都来办公室。
items.src_py: tā měi gè xīng qī dōu lái bàn gōng shì
items.task: Say she has not come to the office for two weeks.
items.zh: 她两个星期没来办公室了。
items.py: tā liǎng gè xīng qī méi lái bàn gōng shì le
items.en: She hasn't come to the office for two weeks.
items.why: The negative version puts 两个星期 before 没 来, not after the verb, and ends with 了 because the absence continues until now.

items.s: 我没喝水一天了。
items.s_py: wǒ méi hē shuǐ yī tiān le
items.zh: 我一天没喝水了。
items.py: wǒ yī tiān méi hē shuǐ le
items.en: I haven't had any water for a day.
items.why: For 'haven't done it for a period', the duration goes before 没: 一天没喝水了. Placing it after the verb and object is the English order.

items.s: 我没学两年，只学了一年。
items.s_py: wǒ méi xué liǎng nián zhǐ xué le yī nián
items.zh: 我没学两年，只学了一年。
items.py: wǒ méi xué liǎng nián zhǐ xué le yī nián
items.en: I didn't study for two years; I only studied for one.
items.why: Trap: here 没 denies the amount, so the duration stays after the verb. This is different from 'haven't done it for two years'.

items.s: 去年他有两个月没上班，在家养病。
items.s_py: qù nián tā yǒu liǎng gè yuè méi shàng bān zài jiā yǎng bìng
items.zh: 去年他有两个月没上班，在家养病。
items.py: qù nián tā yǒu liǎng gè yuè méi shàng bān zài jiā yǎng bìng
items.en: Last year he didn't go to work for two months and stayed at home recovering.
items.why: Trap: the duration 两个月 sits before 没 even in a past period, with 有 introducing it and no final 了. This is correct.

items.q: 这个药一天吃___，每次两片。
items.zh: 这个药一天吃三次，每次两片。
items.py: zhè ge yào yī tiān chī sān cì měi cì liǎng piàn
items.en: Take this medicine three times a day, two tablets each time.
items.why: 次 counts occasions of taking something, here three doses a day. 趟 is for round trips and 下 for a quick, light action, so neither counts doses.

items.q: 今天上午我跑了三___银行，还是没办好。
items.zh: 今天上午我跑了三趟银行，还是没办好。
items.py: jīn tiān shàng wǔ wǒ pǎo le sān tàng yín háng hái shi méi bàn hǎo
items.en: I made three trips to the bank this morning and still haven't got it done.
items.why: 趟 counts trips there and back. 遍 is for running through something from start to finish, and 下 is for a brief action, not a count of trips.

items.q: 头有点疼，我想躺___。
items.zh: 头有点疼，我想躺一下。
items.py: tóu yǒu diǎn téng wǒ xiǎng tǎng yī xià
items.en: My head hurts a little; I want to lie down for a moment.
items.why: 一下 makes a light, brief action: 躺一下. 遍 would mean lying down through something start to finish and 趟 a round trip.

items.q: 老板要求我把合同从头到尾读___，不能漏掉任何一条。
items.zh: 老板要求我把合同从头到尾读两遍，不能漏掉任何一条。
items.py: lǎo bǎn yāo qiú wǒ bǎ hé tong cóng tóu dào wěi dú liǎng biàn bù néng lòu diào rèn hé yī tiáo
items.en: The boss wants me to read the contract through twice from start to finish, without missing a single clause.
items.why: 从头到尾 calls for 遍, a whole run-through. 趟 counts trips, and 下 is a quick action that does not count readings.

items.zh: 他这个星期迟到了三次。
items.py: tā zhè ge xīng qī chí dào le sān cì
items.en: He was late three times this week.
items.why: The count 三次 follows the verb and 了; 这个星期 is a time-when and stays before the verb.

items.zh: 医生一个星期来两次。
items.py: yī shēng yī gè xīng qī lái liǎng cì
items.en: The doctor comes twice a week.
items.why: The period 一个星期 goes before the verb and only the count 两次 follows it.

items.zh: 请你再说一遍。
items.py: qǐng nǐ zài shuō yī biàn
items.en: Please say it once more.
items.why: 遍 follows the verb and counts one whole run-through of what is said. 一遍 cannot come before 说.

items.zh: 我下午要去一趟医院。
items.py: wǒ xià wǔ yào qù yī tàng yī yuàn
items.en: I'm going to make a trip to the hospital this afternoon.
items.why: 趟 counts a trip there and back and follows 去. 下午 is a time-when and stays before the verb. With a place object the count may also follow 医院.

items.src_py: qǐng nǐ kàn zhè ge
items.task: Soften it: look for a moment.
items.zh: 请你看一下这个。
items.py: qǐng nǐ kàn yī xià zhè ge
items.en: Please take a look at this.
items.why: 一下 after the verb softens a request to 'for a moment'. Here it comes before the thing looked at: 看一下这个.

items.s: 这份合同我从头到尾看了两趟。
items.s_py: zhè fèn hé tong wǒ cóng tóu dào wěi kàn le liǎng tàng
items.zh: 这份合同我从头到尾看了两遍。
items.py: zhè fèn hé tong wǒ cóng tóu dào wěi kàn le liǎng biàn
items.en: I read this contract through twice from start to finish.
items.why: 趟 counts trips, so it cannot count readings. Reading a thing through from start to finish is counted with 遍.

items.s: 我们一个星期开一次会。
items.s_py: wǒ men yī gè xīng qī kāi yī cì huì
items.zh: 我们一个星期开一次会。
items.py: wǒ men yī gè xīng qī kāi yī cì huì
items.en: We have a meeting once a week.
items.why: Trap: the period 一个星期 stands before the verb, and only the count 一次 follows it, with the split object 会 last. This is correct.

items.s: 经理明天要去一遍上海出差。
items.s_py: jīng lǐ míng tiān yào qù yī biàn shàng hǎi chū chāi
items.zh: 经理明天要去一趟上海出差。
items.py: jīng lǐ míng tiān yào qù yī tàng shàng hǎi chū chāi
items.en: The manager will make a trip to Shanghai on business tomorrow.
items.why: Going to a place and coming back is counted with 趟. 遍 is for whole run-throughs, so 去一遍 is wrong.

items.q: 我见过___，他是我们的新经理。
items.zh: 我见过他一次，他是我们的新经理。
items.py: wǒ jiàn guo tā yī cì tā shì wǒ men de xīn jīng lǐ
items.en: I have met him once; he's our new manager.
items.why: A pronoun object goes before the count: 见过他一次. 见过一次他 is not allowed with 他, 我 or 你.

items.q: 我跟他只见过一___面，不太熟。
items.zh: 我跟他只见过一次面，不太熟。
items.py: wǒ gēn tā zhǐ jiàn guo yī cì miàn bù tài shú
items.en: I've only met him once; we're not close.
items.why: 见面 is verb + object and splits around the count: 见过一次面. 遍 and 趟 do not count meetings.

items.q: 上个月他请了三次___，经理有点不高兴。
items.zh: 上个月他请了三次假，经理有点不高兴。
items.py: shàng gè yuè tā qǐng le sān cì jià jīng lǐ yǒu diǎn bù gāo xìng
items.en: Last month he took leave three times, and the manager is a bit unhappy.
items.why: 请假 splits around the count: 请了三次假. 请病 and 请班 are not words, so only 假 completes it.

items.q: 医生给我打了两次___，我的烧才退了。
items.zh: 医生给我打了两次针，我的烧才退了。
items.py: yī shēng gěi wǒ dǎ le liǎng cì zhēn wǒ de shāo cái tuì le
items.en: The doctor gave me two injections before my fever went down.
items.why: 打针 is the verb-object for giving an injection, so the count goes in the middle: 打了两次针. 打病 and 打汗 are not used this way, and a fever coming down points to an injection.

items.q: 我在这家医院住过两次___，对这里的医生很熟悉。
items.zh: 我在这家医院住过两次院，对这里的医生很熟悉。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè jiā yī yuàn zhù guo liǎng cì yuàn duì zhè lǐ de yī shēng hěn shú xī
items.en: I have been admitted to this hospital twice, so I know the doctors here well.
items.why: 住院 is verb + object and splits around 过 and the count: 住过两次院. 住病 and 住医 are not words.

items.zh: 这份合同我看了三遍。
items.py: zhè fèn hé tong wǒ kàn le sān biàn
items.en: I have read this contract three times.
items.why: A specific thing like 这份合同 is usually moved to the front as the topic, and the count 三遍 follows the verb.

items.zh: 护士给他量了两次体温。
items.py: hù shi gěi tā liáng le liǎng cì tǐ wēn
items.en: The nurse took his temperature twice.
items.why: A thing object comes after the count: 量了两次体温. The person 他 goes in the 给 phrase before the verb.

items.zh: 我去过两次上海。
items.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì shàng hǎi
items.en: I have been to Shanghai twice.
items.why: With a place object, the count may go on either side: 去过两次上海 or 去过上海两次. Both are fine.

items.zh: 他今天给我打了三次电话。
items.py: tā jīn tiān gěi wǒ dǎ le sān cì diàn huà
items.en: He phoned me three times today.
items.why: A thing object like 电话 comes after the count: 打了三次电话. 今天 is a time-when and can move before or after 他.

items.zh: 他一年只请过一次假。
items.py: tā yī nián zhǐ qǐng guo yī cì jià
items.en: He takes leave only once a year.
items.why: 请假 is verb + object, so the count goes between 请过 and 假. The period 一年 stays before the verb.

items.src_py: wǒ jiàn guo tā
items.task: Say you have met him once.
items.zh: 我见过他一次。
items.py: wǒ jiàn guo tā yī cì
items.en: I have met him once.
items.why: The count 一次 follows the pronoun 他, never precedes it: 见过他一次.

items.src_py: tā lái guo yī yuàn
items.task: Say she has been to the hospital twice.
items.zh: 她来过医院两次。
items.py: tā lái guo yī yuàn liǎng cì
items.en: She has been to the hospital twice.
items.why: With a place object, the count 两次 can go after the place or before it: both 来过医院两次 and 来过两次医院 are correct.

items.s: 我在会上见过一次她。
items.s_py: wǒ zài huì shàng jiàn guo yī cì tā
items.zh: 我在会上见过她一次。
items.py: wǒ zài huì shàng jiàn guo tā yī cì
items.en: I've met her once at a meeting.
items.why: A pronoun object must come before the count. 见过一次她 puts it after, which is not possible with 她.

items.s: 我们只见面过一次。
items.s_py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn miàn guo yī cì
items.zh: 我们只见过一次面。
items.py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo yī cì miàn
items.en: We have only met once.
items.why: 见面 is verb + object and cannot take 过 and a count after 面. They go in the middle: 见过一次面.

items.s: 我看过这个医生两次。
items.s_py: wǒ kàn guo zhè ge yī shēng liǎng cì
items.zh: 我看过这个医生两次。
items.py: wǒ kàn guo zhè ge yī shēng liǎng cì
items.en: I have seen this doctor twice.
items.why: Trap: a noun object like 这个医生 can come before the count; only a pronoun must come first. 看过两次这个医生 is also fine.

items.q: 我昨天晚上___睡觉，睡了八个小时。
items.zh: 我昨天晚上十一点睡觉，睡了八个小时。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shí yī diǎn shuì jiào shuì le bā gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I went to bed at eleven last night and slept for eight hours.
items.why: The clock time 十一点 is a time-when and goes before 睡觉. 十一个小时 is a length and 十一月 is November, so neither fits.

items.q: 他在这家公司干了___，上个月才辞职。
items.zh: 他在这家公司干了三年，上个月才辞职。
items.py: tā zài zhè jiā gōng sī gàn le sān nián shàng gè yuè cái cí zhí
items.en: He worked at this company for three years and only resigned last month.
items.why: After 干了 you need a length of time: 三年. 三号 is a date and 三点 a clock time, which tell when and cannot measure how long.

items.q: 我们___开会，一直开到下午两点半。
items.zh: 我们上午九点开会，一直开到下午两点半。
items.py: wǒ men shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn kāi huì yī zhí kāi dào xià wǔ liǎng diǎn bàn
items.en: We start the meeting at nine in the morning and it runs until half past two in the afternoon.
items.why: The start of the meeting is a point in time, so 上午九点 goes before 开会. A length like 九个小时 or 三个小时 does not tell when it begins.

items.q: 我们的会议星期___开，大家别忘了。
items.zh: 我们的会议星期三开，大家别忘了。
items.py: wǒ men de huì yì xīng qī sān kāi dà jiā bié wàng le
items.en: Our meeting is on Wednesday; everyone, don't forget.
items.why: 星期三 is a day of the week, a time-when before the verb. 三天 and 三个星期 are lengths and cannot name a weekday.

items.q: 经理说他下个月要去上海出差，在那儿一共待___。
items.zh: 经理说他下个月要去上海出差，在那儿一共待两个星期。
items.py: jīng lǐ shuō tā xià gè yuè yào qù shàng hǎi chū chāi zài nà r yī gòng dāi liǎng gè xīng qī
items.en: The manager says he's going to Shanghai on business next month and will stay there two weeks in all.
items.why: How long he stays is a length after the verb: 两个星期. 二月 is February and 两点 is two o'clock, both time-when words.

items.zh: 我星期六早上七点起床。
items.py: wǒ xīng qī liù zǎo shang qī diǎn qǐ chuáng
items.en: I get up at seven on Saturday morning.
items.why: 星期六早上 and 七点 are both time-when words, so they go before the verb, from the larger unit to the smaller. None of them can follow 起床.

items.zh: 他星期二下午开了两个小时会。
items.py: tā xīng qī èr xià wǔ kāi le liǎng gè xiǎo shí huì
items.en: He was in a meeting for two hours on Tuesday afternoon.
items.why: 星期二下午 says when and stays before the verb; 两个小时 says how long and sits between 开了 and 会.

items.zh: 经理三月去北京，在那儿住三个月。
items.py: jīng lǐ sān yuè qù běi jīng zài nà r zhù sān gè yuè
items.en: The manager goes to Beijing in March and will stay there for three months.
items.why: 三月 is March, a time-when before 去; 三个月 is a length of stay after 住. Do not swap them: 三个月 去 and 住 三月 would be wrong.

items.s: 我昨天晚上睡觉十一点。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì jiào shí yī diǎn
items.zh: 我昨天晚上十一点睡觉。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shí yī diǎn shuì jiào
items.en: I went to bed at eleven last night.
items.why: 十一点 says when, so it belongs before the verb. After 睡觉 it would have to be a length, and 十一点 is not one.

items.s: 他在医院住了三月。
items.s_py: tā zài yī yuàn zhù le sān yuè
items.zh: 他在医院住了三个月。
items.py: tā zài yī yuàn zhù le sān gè yuè
items.en: He stayed in the hospital for three months.
items.why: 三月 is March. A length of three months must be 三个月, with 个, and it follows 住了.

items.s: 我下午两点开会，要开两个小时。
items.s_py: wǒ xià wǔ liǎng diǎn kāi huì yào kāi liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 我下午两点开会，要开两个小时。
items.py: wǒ xià wǔ liǎng diǎn kāi huì yào kāi liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I have a meeting at two in the afternoon, and it will take two hours.
items.why: Trap: the time-when 下午两点 is before the verb and the length 两个小时 after it. Each sits in its own slot, so this is correct.

items.s: 我去年在这家公司实习了三个月。
items.s_py: wǒ qù nián zài zhè jiā gōng sī shí xí le sān gè yuè
items.zh: 我去年在这家公司实习了三个月。
items.py: wǒ qù nián zài zhè jiā gōng sī shí xí le sān gè yuè
items.en: Last year I did an internship at this company for three months.
items.why: Trap: 去年 (when) comes before the verb and 三个月 (how long) after 实习了. Two time words in one sentence are fine when they fill different slots.

items.s: 为了准备这个报告，我昨天晚上三个小时加班了。
items.s_py: wèi le zhǔn bèi zhè ge bào gào wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang sān gè xiǎo shí jiā bān le
items.zh: 为了准备这个报告，我昨天晚上加了三个小时班。
items.py: wèi le zhǔn bèi zhè ge bào gào wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang jiā le sān gè xiǎo shí bān
items.en: I worked overtime for three hours last night to prepare this report.
items.why: 三个小时 is a length, not a time-when, so it cannot stand before 加班. It goes between 加了 and 班.

items.q: 我打算在这家健身房练___，然后再换一家。
items.zh: 我打算在这家健身房练三个月，然后再换一家。
items.py: wǒ dǎ suàn zài zhè jiā jiàn shēn fáng liàn sān gè yuè rán hòu zài huàn yī jiā
items.en: I plan to train at this gym for three months and then switch to another one.
items.why: How long I train is a length, written 三个月 with 个, and it follows 练. 三月 is the month of March and cannot be the amount of training.

items.q: 为了退这双鞋，我白跑了两___商场，店员都不在。
items.zh: 为了退这双鞋，我白跑了两趟商场，店员都不在。
items.py: wèi le tuì zhè shuāng xié wǒ bái pǎo le liǎng tàng shāng chǎng diàn yuán dōu bú zài
items.en: To return these shoes I made two wasted trips to the mall, and the staff weren't there.
items.why: 白跑两趟 counts journeys there and back to the mall. 顿 counts meals, 场 counts events and 个 cannot count trips.

items.s: 我在这个城市住了三月，然后换了工作。
items.s_py: wǒ zài zhè ge chéng shì zhù le sān yuè rán hòu huàn le gōng zuò
items.zh: 我在这个城市住了三个月，然后换了工作。
items.py: wǒ zài zhè ge chéng shì zhù le sān gè yuè rán hòu huàn le gōng zuò
items.en: I lived in this city for three months and then changed jobs.
items.why: 三月 is March, a point in time. A length of time is 三个月, and 月 always needs 个 when counting.

items.s: 教练教了小李两年网球。
items.zh: 教练教了小李两年网球。
items.py: jiào liàn jiāo le xiǎo lǐ liǎng nián wǎng qiú
items.en: The coach taught Xiao Li tennis for two years.
items.why: Correct. The person 小李 follows 教了 before the duration, and 网球 closes the sentence. The learner may expect the duration right after 教了.

items.s: 我听了音乐两个小时。
items.s_py: wǒ tīng le yīn yuè liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 我听了两个小时音乐。
items.py: wǒ tīng le liǎng gè xiǎo shí yīn yuè
items.en: I listened to music for two hours.
items.why: The duration goes between 听了 and the object. 听了音乐两个小时 keeps the English order and is not Chinese.

items.s: 这家球馆开业三年了，生意一直不错。
items.zh: 这家球馆开业三年了，生意一直不错。
items.py: zhè jiā qiú guǎn kāi yè sān nián le shēng yi yī zhí bú cuò
items.en: This sports hall has been open for three years, and business has always been good.
items.why: Correct. 开业 starts at one moment, so the time since follows it and ends in 了.

items.q: 我下午要去一___超市，你要买什么吗？
items.zh: 我下午要去一趟超市，你要买什么吗？
items.py: wǒ xià wǔ yào qù yī tàng chāo shì nǐ yào mǎi shén me ma
items.en: I need to make a trip to the supermarket this afternoon. Do you need anything?
items.why: 去一趟 counts a trip there and back. 遍 means doing something through from beginning to end, 场 counts events and 顿 counts meals or scoldings.

items.s: 这个星期我去了三趟超市，每次都忘了买盐。
items.zh: 这个星期我去了三趟超市，每次都忘了买盐。
items.py: zhè gè xīng qī wǒ qù le sān tàng chāo shì měi cì dōu wàng le mǎi yán
items.en: I've been to the supermarket three times this week and each time forgot to buy salt.
items.why: Correct. 趟 counts trips there and back, placed after 去了 and before the place 超市.

items.s: 我在门口等了半天他。
items.s_py: wǒ zài mén kǒu děng le bàn tiān tā
items.zh: 我在门口等了他半天。
items.py: wǒ zài mén kǒu děng le tā bàn tiān
items.en: I waited for him at the door for ages.
items.why: A pronoun object goes between the verb and the duration: 等了他半天. 等了半天他 reverses them.

items.q: 太累了，我们在咖啡馆坐___吧，然后再逛。
items.zh: 太累了，我们在咖啡馆坐一会儿吧，然后再逛。
items.py: tài lèi le wǒ men zài kā fēi guǎn zuò yī huì r ba rán hòu zài guàng
items.en: We're tired. Let's sit in the café for a while and then keep shopping.
items.why: 一会儿 is a short length of time and follows the verb. 一点儿 means a small amount, and 一次 / 一遍 count occasions, so none of them says how long we sit.

items.q: 请等___，我马上给您找零钱。
items.zh: 请等一下，我马上给您找零钱。
items.py: qǐng děng yī xià wǒ mǎ shàng gěi nín zhǎo líng qián
items.en: Please wait a moment. I'll get your change right away.
items.why: 等一下 is the polite 'for a moment'. 一遍 means once through, 一趟 a round trip and 一场 an event, and none of them can follow 等.

items.q: 我昨天在商店逛___两个小时。
items.zh: 我昨天在商店逛了两个小时。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān zài shāng diàn guàng le liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I wandered around the store for two hours yesterday.
items.why: A finished stretch of time follows the verb, with 了 between the verb and the duration. 过 would claim a life experience, which clashes with the specific day 昨天.

items.zh: 他星期六在家睡了十个小时。
items.py: tā xīng qī liù zài jiā shuì le shí gè xiǎo shí
items.en: He slept for ten hours at home on Saturday.
items.why: 星期六 is the point in time and goes before the verb phrase; 十个小时 is the length and follows 睡了. They cannot swap places.

items.src_py: wǒ qù guo nà jiā shāng chǎng
items.task: Say you have been there twice.
items.zh: 我去过两次那家商场。
items.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì nà jiā shāng chǎng
items.en: I've been to that mall twice.
items.why: With a place object the count may go before or after it; either way it stays after 去过.

items.q: 店员又把价格说了一___，我才听清楚。
items.zh: 店员又把价格说了一遍，我才听清楚。
items.py: diàn yuán yòu bǎ jià gé shuō le yī biàn wǒ cái tīng qīng chu
items.en: The clerk said the price once more, and only then did I hear it clearly.
items.why: 说一遍 means saying the whole thing through once more, which is exactly what repeating a price is. 顿 counts meals, 趟 trips and 场 events.

items.zh: 球迷们已经在门口等了四十分钟了。
items.py: qiú mí men yǐ jīng zài mén kǒu děng le sì shí fēn zhōng le
items.en: The fans have already been waiting at the gate for forty minutes.
items.why: 已经 and 在门口 both come before 等了; 四十分钟 follows it and the final 了 closes the sentence.

items.q: 在球场上我见过___，他很高。
items.zh: 在球场上我见过他一次，他很高。
items.py: zài qiú chǎng shàng wǒ jiàn guo tā yī cì tā hěn gāo
items.en: I've met him once on the court, and he's tall.
items.why: A pronoun object goes before the count: 见过他一次. With 他, putting 一次 first is the typical learner error, and 一次的他 is not possible.

items.zh: 我等了她二十分钟。
items.py: wǒ děng le tā èr shí fēn zhōng
items.en: I waited for her for twenty minutes.
items.why: The pronoun 她 comes right after 等了, before the duration. 二十分钟她 would be the English order.

items.s: 我两个小时就逛完了所有的商店。
items.zh: 我两个小时就逛完了所有的商店。
items.py: wǒ liǎng gè xiǎo shí jiù guàng wán le suǒ yǒu de shāng diàn
items.en: It took me only two hours to go round all the shops.
items.why: Correct. With 就 and a result 完, a duration before the verb means 'within that time', a separate pattern from how long an action lasts.

items.s: 他打网球了两个小时。
items.s_py: tā dǎ wǎng qiú le liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 他打了两个小时网球。
items.py: tā dǎ le liǎng gè xiǎo shí wǎng qiú
items.en: He played tennis for two hours.
items.why: 了 belongs right after the verb 打, and the duration follows it before the object. 打网球了两个小时 puts 了 after the object.

items.zh: 我们看了两个小时比赛了。
items.py: wǒ men kàn le liǎng gè xiǎo shí bǐ sài le
items.en: We've been watching the match for two hours now.
items.why: The first 了 follows the verb, the duration sits before the object, and the second 了 closes the sentence to show it is still going on.

items.q: 她每个星期六都去健身房练___。
items.zh: 她每个星期六都去健身房练两个小时。
items.py: tā měi gè xīng qī liù dōu qù jiàn shēn fáng liàn liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.en: Every Saturday she works out at the gym for two hours.
items.why: A habit takes no 了 but the length still follows the verb. 两点 is a clock time, not something you can train for, and a length uses 两 (两个小时), never 二.

items.zh: 弟弟两个星期没去游泳了。
items.py: dì di liǎng gè xīng qī méi qù yóu yǒng le
items.en: My younger brother hasn't been swimming for two weeks.
items.why: 两个星期 stands before 没 and the sentence ends in 了. The duration cannot follow 游泳 because nothing happened to measure.

items.zh: 我打了两年网球。
items.py: wǒ dǎ le liǎng nián wǎng qiú
items.en: I played tennis for two years.
items.why: The duration goes between 打了 and the object. 打了网球两年 is the English order and does not work.

items.q: 去年他在这家球馆打了半年工___，后来去别的城市了。
items.zh: 去年他在这家球馆打了半年工，后来去别的城市了。
items.py: qù nián tā zài zhè jiā qiú guǎn dǎ le bàn nián gōng hòu lái qù bié de chéng shì le
items.en: Last year he worked at this sports hall for half a year, and then he went to another city.
items.why: 去年 and 后来 place the half year firmly in the past, so only the single 了 after the verb is used. A final 了 would mean he is still working there now.

items.zh: 她买衣服买了三个小时了。
items.py: tā mǎi yī fu mǎi le sān gè xiǎo shí le
items.en: She has been shopping for clothes for three hours now.
items.why: In the verb-copy form 了 goes on the second verb, and the final 了 shows the shopping is still going on.

items.q: 我在商场里找了___，你去哪儿了？
items.zh: 我在商场里找了你一个小时，你去哪儿了？
items.py: wǒ zài shāng chǎng lǐ zhǎo le nǐ yī gè xiǎo shí nǐ qù nǎ r le
items.en: I looked for you in the mall for an hour. Where did you go?
items.why: With the pronoun 你, the order is verb + 了 + pronoun + duration. Both options that start with 一个小时 put the duration before the pronoun, which fails.

items.q: 他___去买球鞋，在店里试了半个小时。
items.zh: 他星期六去买球鞋，在店里试了半个小时。
items.py: tā xīng qī liù qù mǎi qiú xié zài diàn lǐ shì le bàn gè xiǎo shí
items.en: He went to buy sports shoes on Saturday and spent half an hour trying them on in the shop.
items.why: 星期六 is a day (when), so it sits before the verb. 六个星期 is a length of six weeks and cannot say when he went.

items.q: 他___了，现在饿坏了。
items.zh: 他一天没吃饭了，现在饿坏了。
items.py: tā yī tiān méi chī fàn le xiàn zài è huài le
items.en: He hasn't eaten for a whole day, and now he's starving.
items.why: The period of not doing something goes BEFORE 没 + verb, with 了 at the end. 没吃一天饭 leaves the duration after the verb, where there is no action to measure.

items.s: 我在商场遇到过一次她。
items.s_py: wǒ zài shāng chǎng yù dào guo yī cì tā
items.zh: 我在商场遇到过她一次。
items.py: wǒ zài shāng chǎng yù dào guo tā yī cì
items.en: I've run into her once in the mall.
items.why: With a pronoun object the count comes after it: 遇到过她一次. 一次她 reverses the order.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn qiú sài
items.task: Say you watched for three hours, repeating the verb.
items.zh: 我昨天看球赛看了三个小时。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn qiú sài kàn le sān gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I watched the match for three hours yesterday.
items.why: To add a duration to verb + object, repeat the verb: 看球赛看了三个小时. 了 goes on the second 看.

items.src: 我用这部手机用了三年。
items.src_py: wǒ yòng zhè bù shǒu jī yòng le sān nián
items.task: Say you have used it for three years and still do.
items.zh: 我用这部手机用了三年了。
items.py: wǒ yòng zhè bù shǒu jī yòng le sān nián le
items.en: I've been using this phone for three years now.
items.why: In the verb-copy form the second 了 goes at the very end, after the duration, to show it continues.

items.zh: 他加入这支球队三年了。
items.py: tā jiā rù zhè zhī qiú duì sān nián le
items.en: He has been on this team for three years.
items.why: 加入 happens in an instant, so the time since then follows the object and the sentence ends in 了. The duration cannot come between 加入 and 这支球队.

items.zh: 我们在球场只见过一次面。
items.py: wǒ men zài qiú chǎng zhǐ jiàn guo yī cì miàn
items.en: We've only met once, at the court.
items.why: 见面 splits around the count, so 见过一次面. The count must stand between 见过 and 面.

items.s: 我没买一年衣服了。
items.s_py: wǒ méi mǎi yī nián yī fu le
items.zh: 我一年没买衣服了。
items.py: wǒ yī nián méi mǎi yī fu le
items.en: I haven't bought clothes for a year.
items.why: The period of not buying goes before 没: 一年没买衣服了. 没买一年衣服 leaves a duration after a verb that never happened.

items.s: 比赛七点开始，大概打一个半小时。
items.zh: 比赛七点开始，大概打一个半小时。
items.py: bǐ sài qī diǎn kāi shǐ dà gài dǎ yī gè bàn xiǎo shí
items.en: The match starts at seven and lasts about an hour and a half.
items.why: Correct. 七点 is the start time, before the verb; 一个半小时 is the length and follows 打.

items.src: 他们打篮球打了一个晚上。
items.src_py: tā men dǎ lán qiú dǎ le yī gè wǎn shang
items.task: Say it without repeating the verb.
items.zh: 他们打了一个晚上篮球。
items.py: tā men dǎ le yī gè wǎn shang lán qiú
items.en: They played basketball all evening.
items.why: Without repeating the verb, the duration is placed between 打了 and the object.

items.s: 这部电影我看了两趟。
items.s_py: zhè bù diàn yǐng wǒ kàn le liǎng tàng
items.zh: 这部电影我看了两遍。
items.py: zhè bù diàn yǐng wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn
items.en: I've watched this film twice.
items.why: 遍 counts viewing something through from start to finish. 趟 counts trips, so 两趟 is wrong with 看.

items.zh: 我在商店见过他一次。
items.py: wǒ zài shāng diàn jiàn guo tā yī cì
items.en: I've met him once in the shop.
items.why: The pronoun 他 comes before the count: 见过他一次. 见过一次他 is the typical error.

items.q: 我在体育馆问过___，他都说不认识你。
items.zh: 我在体育馆问过他两次，他都说不认识你。
items.py: wǒ zài tǐ yù guǎn wèn guo tā liǎng cì tā dōu shuō bú rèn shi nǐ
items.en: I've asked him twice at the gym, and he said both times that he doesn't know you.
items.why: The pronoun 他 comes right after 问过 and before the count: 问过他两次. 问过两次他 is the typical error with a pronoun object.

items.q: 这份说明书我从头到尾看了三___，还是不会用。
items.zh: 这份说明书我从头到尾看了三遍，还是不会用。
items.py: zhè fèn shuō míng shū wǒ cóng tóu dào wěi kàn le sān biàn hái shi bú huì yòng
items.en: I read the instructions through from start to finish three times and I still can't use it.
items.why: 从头到尾 signals reading the whole thing through, which is counted with 遍. 趟 counts trips, 下 is a quick light action and 场 counts events.

items.s: 他已经试了十分钟了衣服，还没出来。
items.s_py: tā yǐ jīng shì le shí fēn zhōng le yī fu hái méi chū lái
items.zh: 他已经试了十分钟衣服了，还没出来。
items.py: tā yǐ jīng shì le shí fēn zhōng yī fu le hái méi chū lái
items.en: He has been trying on clothes for ten minutes already and hasn't come out.
items.why: The second 了 goes at the end of the clause, after the object 衣服. Placed between the duration and the object it is wrong.

items.q: 我们___去体育馆，打了两个小时篮球，才回家。
items.zh: 我们下午四点去体育馆，打了两个小时篮球，才回家。
items.py: wǒ men xià wǔ sì diǎn qù tǐ yù guǎn dǎ le liǎng gè xiǎo shí lán qiú cái huí jiā
items.en: We went to the gym at four in the afternoon, played basketball for two hours, and only then went home.
items.why: The start time is a point (下午四点) and goes before 去; the two hours of play are a length after 打了. A length like 四个小时 cannot say when we set off.

items.zh: 他今年去过两次上海。
items.py: tā jīn nián qù guo liǎng cì shàng hǎi
items.en: He has been to Shanghai twice this year.
items.why: A place name allows both orders after 去过: 两次上海 and 上海两次. 今年 is the time frame and stays before the verb.

items.q: 我们___去超市，大概逛一个小时。
items.zh: 我们三点去超市，大概逛一个小时。
items.py: wǒ men sān diǎn qù chāo shì dà gài guàng yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: We're going to the supermarket at three, and we'll browse for about an hour.
items.why: The time we GO is a point in time, so it comes before 去: 三点. 三个小时 is a length and cannot say when something happens.

items.q: 我以前学了两年游泳___，后来不学了。
items.zh: 我以前学了两年游泳，后来不学了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ qián xué le liǎng nián yóu yǒng hòu lái bù xué le
items.en: I studied swimming for two years before, and then I stopped.
items.why: 以前 and 后来 mark a stretch that is over, so there is no closing 了. A second 了 would say the two years run up to now, which contradicts 后来不学了.

items.zh: 他三月加入球队，训练了三个月。
items.py: tā sān yuè jiā rù qiú duì xùn liàn le sān gè yuè
items.en: He joined the team in March and trained for three months.
items.why: 三月 is the month he joined, so it goes before 加入; 三个月 is the length and follows 训练了. 个 shows it is a length.

items.q: 我昨天游了___。
items.zh: 我昨天游了一个小时泳。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān yóu le yī gè xiǎo shí yǒng
items.en: I swam for an hour yesterday.
items.why: 游泳 is a verb plus object, so it splits around the duration: 游了一个小时泳. 游了泳一个小时 copies the English order, and 泳了 would put a second 了 where none belongs.

items.zh: 我去过这家店三次。
items.py: wǒ qù guo zhè jiā diàn sān cì
items.en: I've been to this shop three times.
items.why: With a place, the count goes on either side: 去过这家店三次 or 去过三次这家店. Both stay after 去过, and the place can also be fronted as the topic.

items.s: 我踢了十年足球了，现在还在踢。
items.zh: 我踢了十年足球了，现在还在踢。
items.py: wǒ tī le shí nián zú qiú le xiàn zài hái zài tī
items.en: I've been playing football for ten years, and I still play.
items.why: Correct. The double 了 is needed because the ten years are counted up to now and 现在还在踢 confirms it continues.

items.zh: 老师帮了我一个下午。
items.py: lǎo shī bāng le wǒ yī gè xià wǔ
items.en: The teacher helped me for a whole afternoon.
items.why: With the pronoun 我 as object, it follows 帮了 immediately and the duration comes last.

items.zh: 我五点去商场逛了一个小时。
items.py: wǒ wǔ diǎn qù shāng chǎng guàng le yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I went to the mall at five and walked around for an hour.
items.why: 五点 is a point in time, placed before the verb; 一个小时 is a length, placed after 逛了. The two are not interchangeable.

items.zh: 我在网上买过两次球鞋。
items.py: wǒ zài wǎng shàng mǎi guo liǎng cì qiú xié
items.en: I've bought sports shoes online twice.
items.why: A thing object follows the count: 买过两次球鞋. The place phrase 在网上 stays before the verb.

items.q: 这家球馆我去___，每次都玩得很开心。
items.zh: 这家球馆我去过三次，每次都玩得很开心。
items.py: zhè jiā qiú guǎn wǒ qù guo sān cì měi cì dōu wán de hěn kāi xīn
items.en: I've been to this sports hall three times, and I had fun every time.
items.why: The count follows the verb AND 过: 去过三次. 过 stays attached to the verb, so 三次过 and 三过次 are impossible.

items.s: 今天我去了一遍银行。
items.s_py: jīn tiān wǒ qù le yī biàn yín háng
items.zh: 今天我去了一趟银行。
items.py: jīn tiān wǒ qù le yī tàng yín háng
items.en: I made a trip to the bank today.
items.why: A journey there and back is counted with 趟. 遍 counts running through something, so 去了一遍银行 is wrong.

items.zh: 我每个周末打两个小时的乒乓球。
items.py: wǒ měi gè zhōu mò dǎ liǎng gè xiǎo shí de pīng pāng qiú
items.en: I play table tennis for two hours every weekend.
items.why: The duration plus 的 sits between the verb and its object. 每个周末 is the time frame and stays before the verb.

items.zh: 小王上周在家休息了三天。
items.py: xiǎo wáng shàng zhōu zài jiā xiū xi le sān tiān
items.en: Xiao Wang rested at home for three days last week.
items.why: 上周 is the time-when and goes before the verb phrase; 三天 is the length and follows 休息了. 三天 cannot go before 休息了.

items.src_py: wǒ men dōu děng le hěn jiǔ
items.task: Say we all waited for her (她) for a long time.
items.zh: 我们都等了她很久。
items.py: wǒ men dōu děng le tā hěn jiǔ
items.en: We all waited for her for a long time.
items.why: The pronoun 她 is inserted right after 等了 and before the duration 很久.

items.src: 我上个月每天都看球赛。
items.src_py: wǒ shàng gè yuè měi tiān dōu kàn qiú sài
items.task: Say you haven't watched a match for over a month.
items.zh: 我已经一个多月没看球赛了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng yī gè duō yuè méi kàn qiú sài le
items.en: I haven't watched a match for over a month now.
items.why: The duration 一个多月 stands before 没 + verb, after 已经, and 了 closes the sentence because it is still true.

items.s: 我跟朋友打羽毛球打了一个下午。
items.zh: 我跟朋友打羽毛球打了一个下午。
items.py: wǒ gēn péng you dǎ yǔ máo qiú dǎ le yī gè xià wǔ
items.en: I played badminton with friends all afternoon.
items.why: Correct. Verb-copy repeats 打, with 了 and the duration on the second one. It looks odd to English speakers but is the normal form.

items.zh: 他买衣服买了一个下午。
items.py: tā mǎi yī fu mǎi le yī gè xià wǔ
items.en: He spent the whole afternoon buying clothes.
items.why: 买衣服 is repeated: the object phrase first, then 买了 with the duration. 了 follows the second 买 only.

items.zh: 他因为工作忙两个月没去健身房了。
items.py: tā yīn wèi gōng zuò máng liǎng gè yuè méi qù jiàn shēn fáng le
items.en: Because work has been busy, he hasn't been to the gym for two months.
items.why: The reason clause comes first, then the duration, then 没 + verb, and a final 了. The duration cannot be put after 去 or after 健身房.

items.zh: 他每天跑半个小时。
items.py: tā měi tiān pǎo bàn gè xiǎo shí
items.en: He runs for half an hour every day.
items.why: 每天 says when and stays before the verb; 半个小时 says how long and follows 跑. A habit takes no 了.

items.zh: 他踢足球踢了三个小时。
items.py: tā tī zú qiú tī le sān gè xiǎo shí
items.en: He played football for three hours.
items.why: Verb-copy: the verb with its object comes first, then the verb again with 了 and the duration. 了 goes on the second verb only.

items.s: 他两个小时在球场上练了。
items.s_py: tā liǎng gè xiǎo shí zài qiú chǎng shàng liàn le
items.zh: 他在球场上练了两个小时。
items.py: tā zài qiú chǎng shàng liàn le liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.en: He practised on the court for two hours.
items.why: How long goes after the verb and 了. In front of the verb it would need 就 and mean 'within two hours', so 两个小时在球场上练了 is wrong.

items.q: 我___了，这件还是去年买的。
items.zh: 我半年没买新衣服了，这件还是去年买的。
items.py: wǒ bàn nián méi mǎi xīn yī fu le zhè jiàn hái shi qù nián mǎi de
items.en: I haven't bought new clothes for half a year. This one is still from last year.
items.why: The duration of not buying goes before 没 (半年没买), with 了 closing the sentence. 没买半年新衣服 copies English and is not used.

items.s: 我今年去过上海两次，都没时间逛街。
items.zh: 我今年去过上海两次，都没时间逛街。
items.py: wǒ jīn nián qù guo shàng hǎi liǎng cì dōu méi shí jiān guàng jiē
items.en: I've been to Shanghai twice this year and had no time to go shopping either time.
items.why: Correct. A place name allows the count on either side: 去过上海两次 equals 去过两次上海.

items.zh: 他们昨天在体育馆训练了整整四个小时。
items.py: tā men zuó tiān zài tǐ yù guǎn xùn liàn le zhěng zhěng sì gè xiǎo shí
items.en: They trained at the gym for a full four hours yesterday.
items.why: 四个小时 follows 训练了 as the length. 整整 may sit right before the number or before the verb; 昨天 and 在体育馆 stay before the verb.

items.q: 我们___了，今天一起打场球吧。
items.zh: 我们两个月没打球了，今天一起打场球吧。
items.py: wǒ men liǎng gè yuè méi dǎ qiú le jīn tiān yī qǐ dǎ chǎng qiú ba
items.en: We haven't played ball for two months. Let's have a game together today.
items.why: For 'haven't done it for two months' the duration comes before 没: 两个月没打球了. 没打两个月球 puts it after the verb, which is the English order.

items.q: 我练了___，身体好多了。
items.zh: 我练了半年瑜伽，身体好多了。
items.py: wǒ liàn le bàn nián yú jiā shēn tǐ hǎo duō le
items.en: I've practised yoga for half a year, and I feel much better.
items.why: The duration goes between 练了 and the object: 练了半年瑜伽. 练了瑜伽半年 puts it after the object as in English, and 了 cannot appear twice.

items.s: 去年他有三个月没打球，所以现在跑不快。
items.zh: 去年他有三个月没打球，所以现在跑不快。
items.py: qù nián tā yǒu sān gè yuè méi dǎ qiú suǒ yǐ xiàn zài pǎo bú kuài
items.en: Last year he didn't play ball for three months, so now he can't run fast.
items.why: Correct. 有三个月 comes before 没打球, the same 'duration before the negative' order, here without a final 了 because it is a past stretch.

items.s: 他今年生过三次病。
items.s_py: tā jīn nián shēng guo sān cì bìng
items.zh: 他今年生过三次病。
items.py: tā jīn nián shēng guo sān cì bìng
items.en: He has been ill three times this year.
items.why: Correct. 生病 is a verb plus object, so 过 and the count go in the middle: 生过三次病. Learners expect 生病过三次, which is heard but is not the pattern to learn.

items.s: 我们明天两个小时打球。
items.s_py: wǒ men míng tiān liǎng gè xiǎo shí dǎ qiú
items.zh: 我们明天打两个小时球。
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān dǎ liǎng gè xiǎo shí qiú
items.en: We'll play ball for two hours tomorrow.
items.why: 明天 is when and goes before the verb; 两个小时 is how long and goes after it. A length before the verb cannot give the duration of playing.

items.s: 我们在球场边休息一会儿吧。
items.zh: 我们在球场边休息一会儿吧。
items.py: wǒ men zài qiú chǎng biān xiū xi yī huì r ba
items.en: Let's rest by the court for a while.
items.why: Correct. 一会儿 is a length of time and follows the verb 休息.

items.q: 上个月他给我打了___，都是问球票的事。
items.zh: 上个月他给我打了三次电话，都是问球票的事。
items.py: shàng gè yuè tā gěi wǒ dǎ le sān cì diàn huà dōu shì wèn qiú piào de shì
items.en: Last month he phoned me three times, always about match tickets.
items.why: A thing object (电话) comes after the count: 打了三次电话. 打了电话三次 puts the count last as English does.

items.q: 上个月他在体育馆练了三个星期拳击___，后来受伤了。
items.zh: 上个月他在体育馆练了三个星期拳击，后来受伤了。
items.py: shàng gè yuè tā zài tǐ yù guǎn liàn le sān gè xīng qī quán jī hòu lái shòu shāng le
items.en: Last month he trained boxing at the gym for three weeks, and then he got injured.
items.why: The three weeks ended when he was injured (后来受伤了), so one 了 after the verb is enough. A second 了 would say the training is still going on.

items.src_py: jiào liàn biǎo yáng guo wǒ
items.task: Say the coach has praised me three times.
items.zh: 教练表扬过我三次。
items.py: jiào liàn biǎo yáng guo wǒ sān cì
items.en: The coach has praised me three times.
items.why: The pronoun 我 stays right after 表扬过 and the count 三次 follows it.

items.s: 我很久没逛街了，今天想多买几件。
items.zh: 我很久没逛街了，今天想多买几件。
items.py: wǒ hěn jiǔ méi guàng jiē le jīn tiān xiǎng duō mǎi jǐ jiàn
items.en: I haven't been shopping for a long time. Today I want to buy a few more things.
items.why: Correct. 很久 is a duration and goes before 没, with 了 at the end because it is still true now.

items.zh: 这首歌我听了五遍。
items.py: zhè shǒu gē wǒ tīng le wǔ biàn
items.en: I listened to this song five times.
items.why: The count 五遍 comes after 听了, and 遍 fits because the song is heard from start to finish. 五遍听了 puts the count in front of the verb.

items.src_py: tā xué le sān gè yuè yóu yǒng
items.task: Say she hasn't been swimming for three months.
items.zh: 她三个月没游泳了。
items.py: tā sān gè yuè méi yóu yǒng le
items.en: She hasn't been swimming for three months.
items.why: When the action does not happen, the duration moves in front of 没, and the sentence ends in 了.

items.s: 上个月我学了三天太极拳了，后来就放弃了。
items.s_py: shàng gè yuè wǒ xué le sān tiān tài jí quán le hòu lái jiù fàng qì le
items.zh: 上个月我学了三天太极拳，后来就放弃了。
items.py: shàng gè yuè wǒ xué le sān tiān tài jí quán hòu lái jiù fàng qì le
items.en: Last month I learned tai chi for three days and then gave up.
items.why: The three days ended when I gave up (后来就放弃了), so only one 了 follows the verb. A final 了 says the learning is still going on.

items.q: 这个月他请___，教练有点不高兴。
items.zh: 这个月他请了三次假，教练有点不高兴。
items.py: zhè gè yuè tā qǐng le sān cì jià jiào liàn yǒu diǎn bù gāo xìng
items.en: He took leave three times this month, and the coach is a little unhappy.
items.why: 请假 is a verb plus object, so 了 and the count go in the middle: 请了三次假. 了假三次 cuts the word apart in the wrong place, and 三次了假 detaches 了 from the verb.

items.q: 我在商店门口等了___。
items.zh: 我在商店门口等了他半个小时。
items.py: wǒ zài shāng diàn mén kǒu děng le tā bàn gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I waited for him at the shop entrance for half an hour.
items.why: A pronoun object comes straight after 等了, before the duration. 半个小时他 is the English order, and 的 never links a duration to a pronoun.

items.zh: 他每天要来回跑两趟。
items.py: tā měi tiān yào lái huí pǎo liǎng tàng
items.en: He has to make two round trips every day.
items.why: 趟 counts trips there and back and follows the verb. 每天 is the period and stays before the verb, just as 来回 stays with it.

items.q: 我陪了___，帮她挑了三双跑鞋。
items.zh: 我陪了她一个下午，帮她挑了三双跑鞋。
items.py: wǒ péi le tā yī gè xià wǔ bāng tā tiāo le sān shuāng pǎo xié
items.en: I kept her company for the whole afternoon and helped her pick three pairs of running shoes.
items.why: 陪 takes the person right after 了, and the length of time comes after the person: 陪了她一个下午. A duration in front of 她, with or without 的, is wrong.

items.q: 他每天都要骑一个小时___自行车。
items.zh: 他每天都要骑一个小时的自行车。
items.py: tā měi tiān dōu yào qí yī gè xiǎo shí de zì xíng chē
items.en: He rides a bicycle for an hour every day.
items.why: With a thing object, 的 can link the duration to the object: 一个小时的自行车. 了 would make it a finished event, which clashes with 每天都要 (a habit), and 着 / 过 do not link a duration to a noun.

items.q: 我们在朋友的婚礼上只见过___，还不太熟。
items.zh: 我们在朋友的婚礼上只见过一次面，还不太熟。
items.py: wǒ men zài péng you de hūn lǐ shàng zhǐ jiàn guo yī cì miàn hái bú tài shú
items.en: We've only met once, at a friend's wedding, so we don't know each other well yet.
items.why: 见面 is a verb-object word and splits around the count: 见过一次面. 见过面一次 leaves the count behind the object 面, which does not work.

items.zh: 我们早上七点爬山，爬了三个小时。
items.py: wǒ men zǎo shang qī diǎn pá shān pá le sān gè xiǎo shí
items.en: We went hiking at seven in the morning and climbed for three hours.
items.why: 早上七点 is when, so it sits before 爬山; 三个小时 is how long, so it follows the second 爬了.

items.q: 我们昨天逛街逛___一个下午，什么也没买。
items.zh: 我们昨天逛街逛了一个下午，什么也没买。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān guàng jiē guàng le yī gè xià wǔ shén me yě méi mǎi
items.en: We spent all yesterday afternoon shopping and bought nothing.
items.why: In the verb-copy form, 了 goes on the second 逛, right before the duration. 过 would mean a general experience, which does not fit the one day 昨天.

items.src_py: tā zǎo shang qī diǎn qù pǎo bù
items.task: Say he ran for an hour in the morning.
items.zh: 他早上跑了一个小时。
items.py: tā zǎo shang pǎo le yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: He ran for an hour in the morning.
items.why: The point in time (七点) becomes a length (一个小时) and moves after the verb; 早上 stays before.

items.zh: 妈妈在医院照顾了他三个星期。
items.py: mā ma zài yī yuàn zhào gù le tā sān gè xīng qī
items.en: Mum looked after him in the hospital for three weeks.
items.why: The pronoun 他 sits between 照顾了 and 三个星期. The place 在医院 stays before the verb.

items.q: 他们已经打了___，现在还在打。
items.zh: 他们已经打了一个小时篮球了，现在还在打。
items.py: tā men yǐ jīng dǎ le yī gè xiǎo shí lán qiú le xiàn zài hái zài dǎ
items.en: They have already been playing basketball for an hour, and they're still playing.
items.why: Still going on calls for a second 了 at the very end, after the object. A 了 between the duration and the object, or a doubled 了 after 打, breaks the pattern.

items.src_py: wǒ liàn le yī nián jí tā
items.task: Say you have been practising for a year and still are.
items.zh: 我练了一年吉他了。
items.py: wǒ liàn le yī nián jí tā le
items.en: I've been practising the guitar for a year now.
items.why: A second 了 at the end of the sentence shows the year is counted up to now and the practice goes on.

items.q: 教练教了___，我们才学会游泳。
items.zh: 教练教了我们三个月，我们才学会游泳。
items.py: jiào liàn jiāo le wǒ men sān gè yuè wǒ men cái xué huì yóu yǒng
items.en: The coach taught us for three months before we learned to swim.
items.why: The pronoun 我们 goes right after 教了 and before 三个月. Putting the duration first, with or without 的, is not Chinese.

items.q: 这家店开业十年___，老顾客特别多。
items.zh: 这家店开业十年了，老顾客特别多。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn kāi yè shí nián le lǎo gù kè tè bié duō
items.en: This shop has been open for ten years, and it has lots of regulars.
items.why: 开业 starts at one moment, so the time since then follows it and the clause ends in 了, counting up to now. 过, 着 and 的 cannot close this pattern.

items.s: 妈妈找了一个小时的你。
items.s_py: mā ma zhǎo le yī gè xiǎo shí de nǐ
items.zh: 妈妈找了你一个小时。
items.py: mā ma zhǎo le nǐ yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: Mum looked for you for an hour.
items.why: With 你, the pronoun comes before the duration, and 的 cannot join them. 一个小时的你 is wrong.

items.zh: 我三天没跑步了。
items.py: wǒ sān tiān méi pǎo bù le
items.en: I haven't gone running for three days.
items.why: The period of not doing something goes before 没; 了 at the end says it is still true. 没跑步三天 leaves the duration after a verb that did not happen.

items.q: 受伤以后他___，所以朋友们都很担心。
items.zh: 受伤以后他一个星期没出门，所以朋友们都很担心。
items.py: shòu shāng yǐ hòu tā yī gè xīng qī méi chū mén suǒ yǐ péng you men dōu hěn dān xīn
items.en: After he got hurt, he didn't go out for a week, so his friends were worried.
items.why: He did not go out for a week: the week goes before 没, and the verb-object 出门 stays together. 没出一个星期门 splits 出门 and leaves the duration behind 没.

items.zh: 他周末踢了两个小时球。
items.py: tā zhōu mò tī le liǎng gè xiǎo shí qiú
items.en: He played ball for two hours at the weekend.
items.why: 两个小时 goes between 踢了 and 球, as for any thing object. 周末 is when and goes before the verb.

items.s: 他在朋友家三天住了。
items.s_py: tā zài péng you jiā sān tiān zhù le
items.zh: 他在朋友家住了三天。
items.py: tā zài péng you jiā zhù le sān tiān
items.en: He stayed at a friend's house for three days.
items.why: The length of stay follows the verb and 了. It cannot stand in front of 住.

items.zh: 我们聊天聊了三个小时。
items.py: wǒ men liáo tiān liáo le sān gè xiǎo shí
items.en: We chatted for three hours.
items.why: The verb is repeated: first with its object (聊天), then again with 了 and the duration. 了 goes on the second verb only.

items.s: 我们聊了一个晚上的天。
items.s_py: wǒ men liáo le yī gè wǎn shang de tiān
items.zh: 我们聊了一个晚上的天。
items.py: wǒ men liáo le yī gè wǎn shang de tiān
items.en: We chatted all evening.
items.why: A duration may be joined to the object with 的: 聊了一个晚上的天. The 的 is correct.

items.zh: 去年冬天我们在哈尔滨住了一个月。
items.py: qù nián dōng tiān wǒ men zài hā ěr bīn zhù le yī gè yuè
items.en: Last winter we stayed in Harbin for a month.
items.why: 去年冬天 is when and goes first, the place phrase sits before the verb and the length 一个月 follows 住了.

items.q: 你等我___，我穿件外套。
items.zh: 你等我一下，我穿件外套。
items.py: nǐ děng wǒ yī xià wǒ chuān jiàn wài tào
items.en: Wait for me a moment, I'll put on a coat.
items.why: 一下 after a verb means 'a moment' and softens the request. 一遍, 一趟 and 一顿 count whole readings, trips and meals, which makes no sense after 等我.

items.src_py: wǒ hé péng you jiàn miàn
items.task: Say we have met three times (use 过).
items.zh: 我和朋友见过三次面。
items.py: wǒ hé péng you jiàn guo sān cì miàn
items.en: I have met my friend three times.
items.why: 见面 splits: 过 and the count go in the middle, 见过三次面. Nothing can follow 面.

items.zh: 我星期天睡了九个小时。
items.py: wǒ xīng qī tiān shuì le jiǔ gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I slept for nine hours on Sunday.
items.why: 星期天 is when, so it goes before the verb. 九个小时 is how long, so it follows 睡了.

items.zh: 上个月我请了三次假。
items.py: shàng gè yuè wǒ qǐng le sān cì jià
items.en: I took leave three times last month.
items.why: 请假 splits around the count: 请了三次假. 上个月 is time-when, so it may come before or after the subject.

items.src: 我们昨天聊了三个小时的天。
items.src_py: wǒ men zuó tiān liáo le sān gè xiǎo shí de tiān
items.task: Rewrite by repeating the verb.
items.zh: 我们昨天聊天聊了三个小时。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān liáo tiān liáo le sān gè xiǎo shí
items.en: We chatted for three hours yesterday.
items.why: The repeated-verb form says the verb with its object first, then again with 了 and the duration.

items.s: 这儿三个月没下雨了。
items.s_py: zhè r sān gè yuè méi xià yǔ le
items.zh: 这儿三个月没下雨了。
items.py: zhè r sān gè yuè méi xià yǔ le
items.en: It hasn't rained here for three months.
items.why: The length 三个月 sits before 没 and the final 了 marks that it is still dry. Correct.

items.s: 我们一个月聚会两次。
items.s_py: wǒ men yī gè yuè jù huì liǎng cì
items.zh: 我们一个月聚会两次。
items.py: wǒ men yī gè yuè jù huì liǎng cì
items.en: We get together twice a month.
items.why: The period 一个月 goes before the verb and the count 两次 follows it. This is correct.

items.q: 最近一直下雨，我们很久没去爬山___。
items.zh: 最近一直下雨，我们很久没去爬山了。
items.py: zuì jìn yī zhí xià yǔ wǒ men hěn jiǔ méi qù pá shān le
items.en: It has rained all the time lately, and we haven't been hiking for a long time.
