items.why: 很久 before 没 means 'not for a long time up to now', which closes with the sentence-final 了. 过, 的 and 着 do not mark the situation so far.

items.q: 我们只见过___，没说过话。
items.zh: 我们只见过一次面，没说过话。
items.py: wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guo yī cì miàn méi shuō guo huà
items.en: We have only met once, we never talked.
items.why: 见面 is a split verb-object word: 过 and the count go in the middle, 见过一次面. The count cannot come after 面 or be scrambled.

items.q: 奶奶生病的时候，妈妈照顾了___三个月。
items.zh: 奶奶生病的时候，妈妈照顾了她三个月。
items.py: nǎi nai shēng bìng de shí hou mā ma zhào gù le tā sān gè yuè
items.en: When Grandma was ill, Mum looked after her for three months.
items.why: A pronoun object comes straight after 照顾了 and before the duration 三个月. 她的 or 她们的 would make a possessive and leave 照顾了 without an object.

items.zh: 我晚上十点睡觉。
items.py: wǒ wǎn shang shí diǎn shuì jiào
items.en: I go to bed at ten in the evening.
items.why: 晚上十点 is a point in time and goes before the verb, either before or after the subject.

items.zh: 我等了他一个小时。
items.py: wǒ děng le tā yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I waited for him for an hour.
items.why: A pronoun object comes right after the verb and before the duration, so 他 precedes 一个小时.

items.q: 夏天我们在海边住了三___。
items.zh: 夏天我们在海边住了三个月。
items.py: xià tiān wǒ men zài hǎi biān zhù le sān gè yuè
items.en: In summer we stayed at the seaside for three months.
items.why: A length of months is 三个月 and needs 个. 三月 is March, a point in time, and 三号 and 三点 are a date and a clock time, none of which can follow 住了 as a length.

items.src_py: tā zài zhè r zhù le shí nián
items.task: Say he has lived here for ten years and still does (add the second 了).
items.zh: 他在这儿住了十年了。
items.py: tā zài zhè r zhù le shí nián le
items.en: He has lived here for ten years.
items.why: A final 了 after the duration says the ten years are counted up to now and he still lives here.

items.zh: 他一个月没给我打电话了。
items.py: tā yī gè yuè méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà le
items.en: He hasn't phoned me for a month.
items.why: 一个月 stands before 没, and 给我 stays before 打电话. The duration may sit before or after the subject.

items.q: 请你再说一___，我没听清楚。
items.zh: 请你再说一遍，我没听清楚。
items.py: qǐng nǐ zài shuō yī biàn wǒ méi tīng qīng chu
items.en: Please say it once more, I didn't hear clearly.
items.why: Saying a whole utterance through again is counted with 遍. 趟 counts trips, and 个 and 口 are not measures for repeating speech.

items.s: 我第一次在北京过冬天。
items.s_py: wǒ dì yī cì zài běi jīng guò dōng tiān
items.zh: 我第一次在北京过冬天。
items.py: wǒ dì yī cì zài běi jīng guò dōng tiān
items.en: This is my first time spending the winter in Beijing.
items.why: 第一次 is a time-when expression and goes before the verb. Correct.

items.s: 我见过一次她。
items.s_py: wǒ jiàn guo yī cì tā
items.zh: 我见过她一次。
items.py: wǒ jiàn guo tā yī cì
items.en: I have met her once.
items.why: A pronoun goes before the count: 见过她一次. The pronoun cannot follow the count.

items.s: 妈妈找了半天的你。
items.s_py: mā ma zhǎo le bàn tiān de nǐ
items.zh: 妈妈找了你半天。
items.py: mā ma zhǎo le nǐ bàn tiān
items.en: Mum looked for you for ages.
items.why: The 的 form works with ordinary nouns only. A pronoun goes straight after the verb: 找了你半天.

items.s: 他陪了我们一个下午。
items.s_py: tā péi le wǒ men yī gè xià wǔ
items.zh: 他陪了我们一个下午。
items.py: tā péi le wǒ men yī gè xià wǔ
items.en: He kept us company all afternoon.
items.why: The pronoun 我们 is placed before the length 一个下午, which is correct.

items.zh: 我们很久没一起吃饭了。
items.py: wǒ men hěn jiǔ méi yī qǐ chī fàn le
items.en: We haven't eaten together for a long time.
items.why: 很久 is the length and must come before 没, with the final 了 for still true now. 没一起吃饭很久 is not the pattern.

items.zh: 小王打了一个下午的篮球。
items.py: xiǎo wáng dǎ le yī gè xià wǔ de lán qiú
items.en: Xiao Wang played basketball all afternoon.
items.why: Verb + 了 + duration + 的 + object. The length stands between verb and object and cannot follow 篮球.

items.src_py: wǒ men zài gōng yuán sàn bù
items.task: Say we did it for two hours (repeat the verb).
items.zh: 我们在公园散步散了两个小时。
items.py: wǒ men zài gōng yuán sàn bù sàn le liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.en: We walked in the park for two hours.
items.why: 散步 is a verb-object word, so the verb is repeated: 散步散了两个小时, with 了 on the second 散.

items.s: 我们学了两年了中文。
items.s_py: wǒ men xué le liǎng nián le zhōng wén
items.zh: 我们学了两年中文了。
items.py: wǒ men xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén le
items.en: We have been studying Chinese for two years.
items.why: The second 了 closes the whole clause, after the object. It cannot sit between the duration and 中文.

items.s: 我们十月去海南，打算住一个星期。
items.s_py: wǒ men shí yuè qù hǎi nán dǎ suàn zhù yī gè xīng qī
items.zh: 我们十月去海南，打算住一个星期。
items.py: wǒ men shí yuè qù hǎi nán dǎ suàn zhù yī gè xīng qī
items.en: We are going to Hainan in October and plan to stay for a week.
items.why: 十月 is when, so it comes before 去. 一个星期 is how long, so it follows 住.

items.src_py: wǒ xué yóu yǒng xué le bàn nián
items.task: Say it has been half a year and I am still learning (add the final 了).
items.zh: 我学游泳学了半年了。
items.py: wǒ xué yóu yǒng xué le bàn nián le
items.en: I have been learning to swim for half a year.
items.why: The repeated-verb form again ends in the second 了, counted up to now: 学游泳学了半年了.

items.q: 我这个星期跑了三___银行，才办好卡。
items.zh: 我这个星期跑了三趟银行，才办好卡。
items.py: wǒ zhè gè xīng qī pǎo le sān tàng yín háng cái bàn hǎo kǎ
items.en: I went to the bank three times this week before I got the card sorted.
items.why: Each go there and back is one 趟. 遍 means from start to finish, 场 counts events and 下 is a brief action, so they do not count separate trips.

items.q: 这首歌太好听了，我听了十___还想听。
items.zh: 这首歌太好听了，我听了十遍还想听。
items.py: zhè shǒu gē tài hǎo tīng le wǒ tīng le shí biàn hái xiǎng tīng
items.en: This song is so lovely, I've listened to it ten times through and still want more.
items.why: Playing a song from beginning to end ten times is counted with 遍. 趟 counts trips, 场 counts performances and 顿 counts meals, so they do not match listening through.

items.q: 昨天下午我们打了两个小时___篮球。
items.zh: 昨天下午我们打了两个小时的篮球。
items.py: zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ men dǎ le liǎng gè xiǎo shí de lán qiú
items.en: We played basketball for two hours yesterday afternoon.
items.why: With an object after the duration, 的 may link the length to the thing. A second 了, 着 or 过 cannot sit between 两个小时 and 篮球; 了 already follows the verb 打.

items.q: 我下午要去一___超市，你要什么吗？
items.zh: 我下午要去一趟超市，你要什么吗？
items.py: wǒ xià wǔ yào qù yī tàng chāo shì nǐ yào shén me ma
items.en: I'm going to make a trip to the supermarket this afternoon, do you want anything?
items.why: A trip there and back is counted with 趟. 遍 means from start to finish, 顿 counts meals and scoldings and 场 counts events, so none fits going to a shop.

items.s: 她在上海工作了两月。
items.s_py: tā zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò le liǎng yuè
items.zh: 她在上海工作了两个月。
items.py: tā zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò le liǎng gè yuè
items.en: She worked in Shanghai for two months.
items.why: A length in months needs 个: 两个月. 两月 is not 'two months', and 月 alone names the calendar months.

items.q: 暑假我们打算去海边玩___，再回北京。
items.zh: 暑假我们打算去海边玩一个星期，再回北京。
items.py: shǔ jià wǒ men dǎ suàn qù hǎi biān wán yī gè xīng qī zài huí běi jīng
items.en: In the summer holidays we plan to play at the seaside for a week, then go back to Beijing.
items.why: The plan needs a length after 玩: 一个星期. A bare 的 would need a noun after it, a final 了 would say it has already been going on, and 星期一 is Monday.

items.zh: 昨天我陪了她一个下午。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ péi le tā yī gè xià wǔ
items.en: Yesterday I kept her company all afternoon.
items.why: The person 她 follows 陪了 and the duration comes last. 昨天 is a time-when word, so it may sit before or after the subject.

items.zh: 朋友在上海工作了两年了。
items.py: péng you zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò le liǎng nián le
items.en: My friend has worked in Shanghai for two years.
items.why: 工作了两年了 with a final 了 says the two years are counted until now and the work continues.

items.s: 我昨天去了一遍超市。
items.s_py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī biàn chāo shì
items.zh: 我昨天去了一趟超市。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī tàng chāo shì
items.en: I went to the supermarket yesterday.
items.why: A trip there and back is 趟. 遍 means doing something through from start to finish.

items.q: 我们等了他半个小时___，他还没来。
items.zh: 我们等了他半个小时了，他还没来。
items.py: wǒ men děng le tā bàn gè xiǎo shí le tā hái méi lái
items.en: We have been waiting for him for half an hour, and he still hasn't come.
items.why: 他还没来 means the waiting is still going on, so the duration is closed with a second 了 at the end of the clause. 过, 着 and 的 do not do that.

items.s: 他没来上课了三个星期。
items.s_py: tā méi lái shàng kè le sān gè xīng qī
items.zh: 他三个星期没来上课了。
items.py: tā sān gè xīng qī méi lái shàng kè le
items.en: He hasn't come to class for three weeks.
items.why: 'Not doing it for three weeks' puts the length before 没: 他三个星期没来上课了. After 没 there is no 了 and nothing for the length to measure.

items.s: 我找了他半天，都没找到。
items.s_py: wǒ zhǎo le tā bàn tiān dōu méi zhǎo dào
items.zh: 我找了他半天，都没找到。
items.py: wǒ zhǎo le tā bàn tiān dōu méi zhǎo dào
items.en: I looked for him for ages and couldn't find him.
items.why: 找了他半天 puts the pronoun before the duration. 半天 here means 'a long time'.

items.s: 他三次迟到了。
items.s_py: tā sān cì chí dào le
items.zh: 他迟到了三次。
items.py: tā chí dào le sān cì
items.en: He was late three times.
items.why: A count follows the verb and 了. It cannot sit before the verb like a time-when.

items.q: 雪下了两天___，现在还在下。
items.zh: 雪下了两天了，现在还在下。
items.py: xuě xià le liǎng tiān le xiàn zài hái zài xià
items.en: It has been snowing for two days, and it's still snowing.
items.why: 现在还在下 says the snow is still going, so the amount is counted up to now with a second 了 at the end. 过, 的 and 着 cannot close the clause like this.

items.zh: 我和朋友聊天聊了两个小时了。
items.py: wǒ hé péng you liáo tiān liáo le liǎng gè xiǎo shí le
items.en: My friend and I have been chatting for two hours.
items.why: In the repeated-verb form the second 了 goes last, after the duration, to say the chat is still going: 聊天聊了两个小时了.

items.zh: 我们在雨里等了她半个小时。
items.py: wǒ men zài yǔ lǐ děng le tā bàn gè xiǎo shí
items.en: We waited for her in the rain for half an hour.
items.why: The pronoun 她 comes before the length 半个小时. The place phrase 在雨里 sits before the verb, either before or after 我们.

items.zh: 李老师教了我们三年。
items.py: lǐ lǎo shī jiāo le wǒ men sān nián
items.en: Mr. Li taught us for three years.
items.why: Pronoun 我们 goes between 教了 and the duration 三年, never after it.

items.zh: 他八月去上海住三个月。
items.py: tā bā yuè qù shàng hǎi zhù sān gè yuè
items.en: In August he goes to Shanghai and stays for three months.
items.why: 八月 is a point in time and goes before 去. 住三个月 is a length and follows its verb. The two months-words are different things.

items.q: 去年我在上海工作了___，今年回北京了。
items.zh: 去年我在上海工作了八个月，今年回北京了。
items.py: qù nián wǒ zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò le bā gè yuè jīn nián huí běi jīng le
items.en: Last year I worked in Shanghai for eight months, this year I'm back in Beijing.
items.why: 工作了 takes a length after it, so 八个月 'eight months'. 八月 is August, a point in time, and 八号 and 八点 are a date and a clock time.

items.zh: 我们一个星期见一次面。
items.py: wǒ men yī gè xīng qī jiàn yī cì miàn
items.en: We meet once a week.
items.why: The period 一个星期 goes before the verb, the count 一次 follows it, and 见面 splits so 面 comes last.

items.zh: 他们认识了五年了。
items.py: tā men rèn shi le wǔ nián le
items.en: They have known each other for five years.
items.why: 认识了五年了: the first 了 follows the verb and the final 了 marks that the five years are counted up to now.

items.q: 他___没来上课了，大家都很担心。
items.zh: 他三天没来上课了，大家都很担心。
items.py: tā sān tiān méi lái shàng kè le dà jiā dōu hěn dān xīn
items.en: He hasn't come to class for three days, and everyone is worried.
items.why: The length of absence goes before 没, and 三天 gives 'three days'. 三月 is March, 三点钟 is a clock time and 三次 counts occasions, none of which gives the length 'three days'.

items.q: 我们昨天爬山爬___四个小时才到山顶。
items.zh: 我们昨天爬山爬了四个小时才到山顶。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān pá shān pá le sì gè xiǎo shí cái dào shān dǐng
items.en: Yesterday we climbed for four hours before reaching the summit.
items.why: The repeated-verb pattern puts 了 on the second 爬, then the duration. 过 and 着 do not fit a finished stretch with 昨天, and 完 would need a different structure.

items.src_py: tā yǐ qián cháng gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
items.task: Say he hasn't phoned me for two weeks.
items.zh: 他两个星期没给我打电话了。
items.py: tā liǎng gè xīng qī méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà le
items.en: He hasn't phoned me for two weeks.
items.why: In the negative the period moves in front of 没, and 了 ends the sentence. 没打电话两个星期 is not the pattern.

items.zh: 她每天睡八个小时的觉。
items.py: tā měi tiān shuì bā gè xiǎo shí de jiào
items.en: She sleeps eight hours every day.
items.why: 睡觉 is verb + object, so it splits around the duration: 睡八个小时的觉. 睡觉八个小时 is wrong. A habit takes no 了.

items.src_py: wǒ zài yǔ lǐ děng péng you
items.task: Say I waited for him for an hour (past).
items.zh: 我在雨里等了他一个小时。
items.py: wǒ zài yǔ lǐ děng le tā yī gè xiǎo shí
items.en: I waited for him in the rain for an hour.
items.why: The pronoun 他 comes right after 等了, before the length. The place 在雨里 stays before the verb.

items.q: 昨天晚上我跟朋友打___两个小时电话。
items.zh: 昨天晚上我跟朋友打了两个小时电话。
items.py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ gēn péng you dǎ le liǎng gè xiǎo shí diàn huà
items.en: Last night I was on the phone with a friend for two hours.
items.why: A finished stretch takes 了 right after 打, then the duration, then the object. 着 and 过 cannot fit a specific time like 昨天晚上, and 的 cannot replace 了 after a verb.

items.q: 去年夏天，我们在海边住了一个月___，后来就回家了。
items.zh: 去年夏天，我们在海边住了一个月，后来就回家了。
items.py: qù nián xià tiān wǒ men zài hǎi biān zhù le yī gè yuè hòu lái jiù huí jiā le
items.en: Last summer we stayed at the seaside for a month and then went home.
items.why: 去年夏天 and 后来 place the stay entirely in the past, so a single 了 is enough. A final 了 would say 'a month so far, still there', which contradicts 后来就回家了.

items.q: 下雪天，他们在山上玩了___，晚上才回来。
items.zh: 下雪天，他们在山上玩了四个小时，晚上才回来。
items.py: xià xuě tiān tā men zài shān shang wán le sì gè xiǎo shí wǎn shang cái huí lái
items.en: On the snowy day they played on the mountain for four hours and only came back in the evening.
items.why: 玩了 is followed by a length, 四个小时. 四点, 四月 and 四号 are a clock time, a month and a date, all time-when words that go before the verb.

items.q: 昨天雨下___三个小时。
items.zh: 昨天雨下了三个小时。
items.py: zuó tiān yǔ xià le sān gè xiǎo shí
items.en: It rained for three hours yesterday.
items.why: A stretch of rain that is over takes 了 between 下 and the duration. 过 would mean 'has ever rained for three hours', and 着 describes a continuing state, neither fits 昨天.

items.s: 去年冬天我去过哈尔滨两次。
items.s_py: qù nián dōng tiān wǒ qù guo hā ěr bīn liǎng cì
items.zh: 去年冬天我去过哈尔滨两次。
items.py: qù nián dōng tiān wǒ qù guo hā ěr bīn liǎng cì
items.en: I went to Harbin twice last winter.
items.why: A place name may come before the count, 去过哈尔滨两次, as well as after it. Both are fine.

items.q: 我感冒了，一个星期没出门___。
items.zh: 我感冒了，一个星期没出门了。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le yī gè xīng qī méi chū mén le
items.en: I caught a cold and haven't gone out for a week.
items.why: 一个星期 before 没 plus final 了 says 'for a week up to now'. 过 would change it to 'never went out', 的 and 着 do not close the clause.

items.q: 李老师教了我们___。
items.zh: 李老师教了我们两年。
items.py: lǐ lǎo shī jiāo le wǒ men liǎng nián
items.en: Mr. Li taught us for two years.
items.why: After the pronoun object comes the duration 两年. 两月 is not a length (it needs 个), 两点 is two o'clock, and 两次 counts occasions rather than the time taught.

items.zh: 大雨下了整整三天。
items.py: dà yǔ xià le zhěng zhěng sān tiān
items.en: The heavy rain lasted a full three days.
items.why: The duration 整整三天 follows 下了. It cannot go in front of the verb as a time-when.

items.q: 我们明天___去公园。
items.zh: 我们明天两点去公园。
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān liǎng diǎn qù gōng yuán
items.en: We are going to the park at two o'clock tomorrow.
items.why: 去公园 needs a point in time before the verb: 两点 is two o'clock. 两个小时, 两年 and 两天 are lengths and cannot stand in the time-when slot.

items.src_py: wǒ men sān diǎn liáo tiān
items.task: Say we chatted for three hours.
items.zh: 我们聊了三个小时的天。
items.py: wǒ men liáo le sān gè xiǎo shí de tiān
items.en: We chatted for three hours.
items.why: The length goes after 聊了, with 的 linking it to the object 天. The time-when 三点 became a length 三个小时 and moved after the verb.

items.s: 我们昨天聊天了两个小时。
items.s_py: wǒ men zuó tiān liáo tiān le liǎng gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 我们昨天聊了两个小时的天。
items.py: wǒ men zuó tiān liáo le liǎng gè xiǎo shí de tiān
items.en: We chatted for two hours yesterday.
items.why: 聊天 splits when a duration is added: 聊了两个小时的天, or 聊天聊了两个小时. 了 cannot come after the whole word 聊天.

items.s: 我们三个小时爬了山。
items.s_py: wǒ men sān gè xiǎo shí pá le shān
items.zh: 我们爬了三个小时的山。
items.py: wǒ men pá le sān gè xiǎo shí de shān
items.en: We climbed for three hours.
items.why: A length of time cannot stand before the verb as 'when'. It goes after 爬了.

items.q: 小李帮了___一个下午的忙。
items.zh: 小李帮了我一个下午的忙。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ bāng le wǒ yī gè xià wǔ de máng
items.en: Xiao Li helped me out for a whole afternoon.
items.why: The person goes right after 帮了, before the duration: 帮了我一个下午的忙. A possessive such as 我的 would turn the person into a modifier and break the sentence.

items.s: 她游泳游了半个小时。
items.s_py: tā yóu yǒng yóu le bàn gè xiǎo shí
items.zh: 她游泳游了半个小时。
items.py: tā yóu yǒng yóu le bàn gè xiǎo shí
items.en: She swam for half an hour.
items.why: Repeating the verb is correct: 游泳游了半个小时. 了 sits on the second 游.

items.q: 明年夏天我想在海边住___一个月。
items.zh: 明年夏天我想在海边住一个月。
items.py: míng nián xià tiān wǒ xiǎng zài hǎi biān zhù yī gè yuè
items.en: Next summer I want to stay at the seaside for a month.
items.why: A plan is not finished, so no 了 follows 住; the duration still comes after the verb. 了, 着 and 过 all mark an action that has already happened or is under way.

items.q: 天气预报说明天有雨，你问___一下，要不要带伞？
items.zh: 天气预报说明天有雨，你问他一下，要不要带伞？
items.py: tiān qì yù bào shuō míng tiān yǒu yǔ nǐ wèn tā yī xià yào bu yào dài sǎn
items.en: The forecast says rain tomorrow, ask him whether he is bringing an umbrella.
items.why: A pronoun object goes before 一下, giving 问他一下. 他的 and 的他 are not possible there, and 了 would turn it into a completed action.

items.zh: 我三天没出门了。
items.py: wǒ sān tiān méi chū mén le
items.en: I haven't gone out for three days.
items.why: The length of not doing goes before 没, and the final 了 marks that it is still true. 没出门三天 is not the pattern.

items.zh: 雪已经下了三天了。
items.py: xuě yǐ jīng xià le sān tiān le
items.en: It has already been snowing for three days.
items.why: 已经 and the final 了 both say 'so far'. The duration follows 下了 and the second 了 ends the sentence.

items.zh: 他给我打了三次电话。
items.py: tā gěi wǒ dǎ le sān cì diàn huà
items.en: He phoned me three times.
items.why: The count 三次 goes between 打了 and the thing 电话. Putting 电话 before the count, as in English, is wrong.

items.s: 我们见面过两次。
items.s_py: wǒ men jiàn miàn guo liǎng cì
items.zh: 我们见过两次面。
items.py: wǒ men jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn
items.en: We have met twice.
items.why: 见面 is verb + object, so 过 and the count go between the two syllables. 见面过 cannot be stuck together.

items.zh: 我只见过他两次。
items.py: wǒ zhǐ jiàn guo tā liǎng cì
items.en: I have only met him twice.
items.why: The pronoun 他 comes before the count 两次. 只 sits before the verb.

items.q: 他___去上海，要住两个星期。
items.zh: 他下个月去上海，要住两个星期。
items.py: tā xià gè yuè qù shàng hǎi yào zhù liǎng gè xīng qī
items.en: He is going to Shanghai next month and will stay for two weeks.
items.why: 去上海 needs a point in time before the verb: 下个月 is next month. 一个月, 三个月 and 半个月 are lengths and belong after a verb such as 住.

items.zh: 我们在雪地里玩了一个下午。
items.py: wǒ men zài xuě dì lǐ wán le yī gè xià wǔ
items.en: We played in the snow all afternoon.
items.why: The duration 一个下午 follows 玩了. The place phrase may come before or after the subject, but the length can never move in front of the verb.

items.src_py: qǐng nǐ děng
items.task: Soften it: wait for a moment.
items.zh: 请你等一下。
items.py: qǐng nǐ děng yī xià
items.en: Please wait a moment.
items.why: 一下 after the verb makes the request short and polite: 等一下.

items.zh: 我去过两次北京。
items.py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì běi jīng
items.en: I have been to Beijing twice.
items.why: A place name can sit either side of the count: 去过两次北京 or 去过北京两次. The count must follow 过 and cannot go before 去.

items.zh: 春天我们去过两次杭州。
items.py: chūn tiān wǒ men qù guo liǎng cì háng zhōu
items.en: We have been to Hangzhou twice in spring.
items.why: A place may follow the count or come before it, so both orders are fine, but the count must come after 过, not before 去.

items.q: 我们在咖啡馆坐了一个下午___，雨还没停。
items.zh: 我们在咖啡馆坐了一个下午了，雨还没停。
items.py: wǒ men zài kā fēi guǎn zuò le yī gè xià wǔ le yǔ hái méi tíng
items.en: We have been sitting in the cafe for a whole afternoon, and the rain still hasn't stopped.
items.why: 雨还没停 shows the sitting is still going on, so the duration is counted up to now with a final 了. 过, 着 and 的 cannot end the clause.

items.q: 因为天气太热，我们已经___没聚会了。
items.zh: 因为天气太热，我们已经半个月没聚会了。
items.py: yīn wèi tiān qì tài rè wǒ men yǐ jīng bàn gè yuè méi jù huì le
items.en: Because of the heat, we haven't had a get-together for half a month now.
items.why: The length 半个月 stands before 没 to say how long it has been. 半个月前 means 'half a month ago', a point in time, and 半个月的 would need a noun after it.

items.s: 我跟她见过两次面，还不熟。
items.s_py: wǒ gēn tā jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn hái bù shú
items.zh: 我跟她见过两次面，还不熟。
items.py: wǒ gēn tā jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn hái bù shú
items.en: I have met her twice and we aren't close yet.
items.why: 见面 splits around the count: 见过两次面. Correct.

items.s: 雪已经下了三天了，还没有停。
items.s_py: xuě yǐ jīng xià le sān tiān le hái méi yǒu tíng
items.zh: 雪已经下了三天了，还没有停。
items.py: xuě yǐ jīng xià le sān tiān le hái méi yǒu tíng
items.en: It has been snowing for three days now and it hasn't stopped.
items.why: The final 了 is correct because the three days are counted up to now and the snow continues.

items.zh: 朋友们很久没聚会了。
items.py: péng you men hěn jiǔ méi jù huì le
items.en: My friends haven't had a get-together for a long time.
items.why: 很久 is the length and must precede 没. It can come before or after the subject, but not after 聚会.

items.q: 我星期六上午___去爬山，大概爬三个小时。
items.zh: 我星期六上午九点去爬山，大概爬三个小时。
items.py: wǒ xīng qī liù shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn qù pá shān dà gài pá sān gè xiǎo shí
items.en: On Saturday morning I'm going hiking at nine, for about three hours.
items.why: 去爬山 needs a point in time before it: 九点. The length 三个小时 follows the second 爬. 九个小时, 九年 and 九次 are lengths or counts that cannot name a clock time.

items.s: 我没在北京住三年，只住了两年。
items.s_py: wǒ méi zài běi jīng zhù sān nián zhǐ zhù le liǎng nián
items.zh: 我没在北京住三年，只住了两年。
items.py: wǒ méi zài běi jīng zhù sān nián zhǐ zhù le liǎng nián
items.en: I didn't live in Beijing for three years, only two.
items.why: Here 没 denies the amount: it is 'not three years', so the duration stays after the verb. This differs from 'for three years not'.

items.q: 上个月我请了两次___，都是因为感冒。
items.zh: 上个月我请了两次假，都是因为感冒。
items.py: shàng gè yuè wǒ qǐng le liǎng cì jià dōu shì yīn wèi gǎn mào
items.en: Last month I took leave twice, both times because of a cold.
items.why: 请假 is a split verb-object word, so the count goes between: 请了两次假. 请 does not pair with 病, 班 or 课 in this meaning.

items.zh: 今天下了一整天雨。
items.py: jīn tiān xià le yī zhěng tiān yǔ
items.en: It rained all day today.
items.why: With 雨 after the verb, the duration sits between 下了 and the object: 下了一整天雨. Or 雨 is fronted as topic: 今天雨下了一整天. 一整天 cannot go before the verb.

items.q: 夏天我去过两___北京，冬天还没去过。
items.zh: 夏天我去过两次北京，冬天还没去过。
items.py: xià tiān wǒ qù guo liǎng cì běi jīng dōng tiān hái méi qù guo
items.en: I have been to Beijing twice in summer, but not yet in winter.
items.why: Occasions are counted with 次 right after 过. 个 and 条 are measures for things, and 点 is for clock times, so they cannot count visits.

items.q: 我们___没见面了。
items.zh: 我们三个月没见面了。
items.py: wǒ men sān gè yuè méi jiàn miàn le
items.en: We haven't seen each other for three months.
items.why: 'Have not done it for three months' puts the length before 没: 三个月没见面了. 三月 is March, 三点 is three o'clock and 三次 counts occasions, so none gives 'three months'.

items.zh: 我来北京两年了。
items.py: wǒ lái běi jīng liǎng nián le
items.en: It has been two years since I came to Beijing.
items.why: 来 happens in an instant, so the time counts from it: Verb + Object + duration + 了.
